killer:a-nurses-calling.summary: You see Survivors who are healing or being healed near you.
facts: You see Survivors who are healing or being healed within 28/30/32 metres.
killer:a-nurses-calling.tip: Run it with Sloppy Butcher so Survivors spend longer healing.

killer:agitation.summary: You carry Survivors to hooks faster, but everyone hears you from further away while you do.
facts: While you carry a Survivor, you move 14/16/18% faster.
While you carry, your Terror Radius grows by 12 metres.
killer:agitation.tip: It helps you reach a far hook before the Survivor wiggles free.

killer:alien-instinct.summary: Each hook shows you the farthest injured Survivor and stops them from hearing your Terror Radius.
facts: When you hook a Survivor, you see the farthest injured Survivor for 8 seconds.
That Survivor becomes Oblivious for 40/50/60 seconds.
killer:alien-instinct.tip: Go straight to the revealed Survivor while they cannot hear you.

killer:all-shaking-thunder.summary: After you drop from a height, your lunge reaches much further for a short time.
facts: After you fall from a height, it is active for 15/20/25 seconds.
Your lunge reaches 75% further.
The cool-down is 5 seconds.
killer:all-shaking-thunder.tip: On maps with many drops, jump down right behind a Survivor.

killer:awakened-awareness.summary: While you carry a Survivor, you see the teammates who come close to save them.
facts: While you carry a Survivor, you see any Survivor within 16/18/20 metres.
killer:awakened-awareness.tip: Drop the carried Survivor to hit a teammate who comes too close.

killer:bamboozle.summary: You vault faster, and each window you vault is closed to Survivors for a while.
facts: You always vault 5/10/15% faster.
After you vault a window, Survivors cannot use it for 8/12/16 seconds.
Vaulting the same window again restarts the timer. Vaulting another window moves the block there.
It does not apply to vaulting dropped pallets.
killer:bamboozle.tip: Vault the window at a strong loop to force Survivors away from it.

killer:barbecue-and-chilli.summary: After each hook you briefly see the Survivors who are far from that hook.
facts: After you hook a Survivor, you see every Survivor 60/50/40 metres or further from that hook for 5 seconds.
killer:barbecue-and-chilli.tip: Use the reveal to pick your next target right after a hook.

killer:batteries-included.summary: Near a completed generator you move a little faster, and the boost stays briefly when you leave.
facts: You get +5% Haste when you are 16 metres or closer to a completed generator.
The Haste stays for 1/3/5 seconds after you leave.
killer:batteries-included.tip: Chase near finished generators to catch Survivors sooner.

killer:beast-of-prey.summary: When you gain Bloodlust in a chase, you also become Undetectable for a while.
facts: When you gain Bloodlust, you are Undetectable for 30/35/40 seconds.
killer:beast-of-prey.tip: After a down in a long chase, you can sneak up on the next Survivor.

killer:bitter-murmur.summary: Each finished generator shows the Survivors near it, and the last one shows everyone.
facts: When a generator is completed, you see Survivors within 20 metres of it for 10 seconds.
When the last generator is completed, you see all Survivors for 16/18/20 seconds.
killer:bitter-murmur.tip: Go to the revealed Survivors at once, because they are often still together.

killer:blood-echo.summary: Each hook makes every injured Survivor Exhausted and unable to heal well.
facts: When you hook a Survivor, all injured Survivors become Exhausted and Haemorrhaged for 20/25/30 seconds.
killer:blood-echo.tip: Run it with perks that injure Survivors, so every hook blocks their sprint perks.

killer:blood-warden.summary: Once a gate is open, one endgame hook can trap the remaining Survivors inside.
facts: It activates when any Exit Gate has been opened.
You see Survivors who stand in an Exit Gate area.
Once per match, a hook while it is active closes off every open Exit Gate for 40/50/60 seconds.
During that time no Survivor can leave through them.
killer:blood-warden.tip: Hook a Survivor close to the gate to trap the teammates who come to save them.

killer:bloodhound.summary: The blood of injured Survivors is easier to see and stays longer.
facts: Blood from injured Survivors is bright red.
It stays 2/3/4 seconds longer.
killer:bloodhound.tip: Use it to follow injured Survivors who break line of sight.

killer:brutal-strength.summary: You break walls and pallets and kick generators faster.
facts: You break or damage walls, pallets and generators 10/15/20% faster.
killer:brutal-strength.tip: It suits Killers who have to break many pallets in a chase.

killer:call-of-brine.summary: Generators you kick regress faster, and you hear Survivors who hit Good skill checks on them.
facts: After you damage a generator, the effect lasts 90 seconds on it.
It regresses at 130/140/150% of normal speed.
You see that generator in yellow.
A Good skill check on it gives you a Loud Noise Notification.
killer:call-of-brine.tip: Run it with Pop Goes the Weasel or Eruption for strong slowdown.

killer:celestial-witness.summary: You see the Obsession when they are far away. If they are close, someone farther away takes over as Obsession.
facts: The check runs every 30 seconds.
If the Obsession is at a distance of 40 metres from you, they show to you for 2/2.5/3 seconds.
If not, the Survivor farthest from you takes over as the Obsession.
killer:celestial-witness.tip: Use the reveals to find the Obsession for an early chase.

killer:corrupt-intervention.summary: The three generators farthest from you are blocked at the start, which gives you time for the first down.
facts: At the start, the 3 generators farthest from you are blocked for 80/100/120 seconds.
It ends early as soon as the first Survivor goes down.
killer:corrupt-intervention.tip: Patrol the open generators near you, because Survivors have to come to them.

killer:coulrophobia.summary: Survivors inside your Terror Radius heal slower and get faster healing skill checks.
facts: In your Terror Radius, all healing is 20/25/30% slower.
The needle on healing skill checks moves 50% faster.
killer:coulrophobia.tip: Stay near injured Survivors to keep their heals slow.

killer:coup-de-grace.summary: Each finished generator gives tokens that make your next lunges reach further.
facts: You gain 2 Tokens for each completed generator, up to 10 Tokens per match.
Your next lunge reaches 70/75/80% further and uses 1 Token.
You can hold at most 5 Tokens at a time.
killer:coup-de-grace.tip: Save the long lunge for a Survivor who thinks they are out of reach.

killer:cruel-limits.summary: Each finished generator closes all windows to Survivors for a short time.
facts: When a generator is completed, all windows are blocked for Survivors for 20/25/30 seconds.
You see the blocked windows in yellow.
killer:cruel-limits.tip: Start chases at window loops right after a generator pops.

killer:cull-the-weak.summary: Hooking anyone but the Obsession slows the rest of the team, while the Obsession gets faster at rescues.
facts: You gain 1 Token for each hook on anyone other than the Obsession.
While the Obsession lives, the other Survivors repair, heal and sabotage 2/2.5/3% slower for each token.
The penalty stops at 22/27.5/33%, which is 11 Tokens.
The Obsession is not slowed and unhooks and heals others 33% faster.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:cull-the-weak.tip: Leave the Obsession for last to keep the penalty running.

killer:dark-arrogance.summary: You vault windows faster and recover faster from attacks, but stuns and blinds hurt you more.
facts: You vault windows 15/20/25% faster.
You recover from basic attacks 10% faster.
You recover from pallet stuns 25% slower.
Blinds on you last 25% longer.
killer:dark-arrogance.tip: Use it on Killers who are rarely stunned or blinded.

killer:dark-devotion.summary: When you hurt the Obsession, your Terror Radius moves to them and you become Undetectable.
facts: When the Obsession gets injured, it is active for 35/40/45 seconds.
Your Terror Radius moves to the Obsession and is set to 40 metres.
You are Undetectable.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:dark-devotion.tip: Hit the Obsession near other Survivors to scare them while you sneak up.

killer:darkness-revealed.summary: When you open a locker, you see Survivors near any locker on the map.
facts: When you search a locker, you see Survivors who are 8 metres or closer to any locker, for 6/7/8 seconds.
The cool-down is 30 seconds.
killer:darkness-revealed.tip: Open a locker on your way to a generator to check for Survivors.

killer:dead-mans-switch.summary: After a hook, the first generator a Survivor lets go of is blocked for a while.
facts: It triggers after you hook a Survivor.
When a Survivor lets go of a generator for 2 seconds, the first such generator is blocked for 30/35/40 seconds.
You see that generator in white.
It cannot trigger again while the previous block is still on.
killer:dead-mans-switch.tip: Run it with Grim Embrace or Pain Resonance for more generator control.

killer:deadlock.summary: Each finished generator blocks the most advanced remaining generator for a short time.
facts: When a generator is completed, the generator with the most progress is blocked for 15/20/25 seconds.
You see the blocked generator in white.
killer:deadlock.tip: Patrol the blocked generator, because Survivors come back to it when the block ends.

killer:deathbound.summary: A Survivor who heals another screams and becomes Oblivious when they move away from that Survivor.
facts: It triggers when a Survivor heals another Survivor by 1 health state.
The healer screams, which shows you where they are.
The healer is Oblivious when more than 12/8/4 metres from the healed Survivor.
The healer sees the healed Survivor while it lasts.
It ends once the healer gets hit or otherwise drops a health state.
killer:deathbound.tip: Chase the healer after the scream, because they cannot hear you coming.

killer:deerstalker.summary: Survivors who read your aura are shown to you, and you show yourself to the least-chased Survivor.
facts: When a Survivor reads your aura, you see their aura for the same time.
Every 40/35/30 seconds, the Survivor with the least total chase time sees your aura for 4 seconds.
killer:deerstalker.tip: Use the reveals to find Survivors who run aura perks.

killer:discordance.summary: Generators with two or more Survivors on them are marked for you.
facts: Generators within 64/96/128 metres with 2 or more Survivors on them show in yellow.
When a generator is first marked, you get a Loud Noise Notification.
The mark stays 4 seconds after the generator leaves your range or only 1 Survivor is left on it.
killer:discordance.tip: Break up group repairs early to stop fast generators.

killer:dissolution.summary: After you hit a Survivor, the next pallet they fast-vault near you breaks at once.
facts: It activates 3 seconds after you injure a Survivor with a basic attack, and lasts 13/14/15 seconds.
The next pallet that Survivor fast-vaults inside your Terror Radius breaks at once.
killer:dissolution.tip: Keep pressure on the injured Survivor so they vault a pallet.

killer:distressing.summary: Your Terror Radius is larger, and Survivors inside it repair more slowly.
facts: Your Terror Radius is always 30% larger.
Survivors inside your Terror Radius repair generators 6/7/8% slower.
killer:distressing.tip: Run it with Terror Radius perks such as Coulrophobia or Overcharge.

killer:dominance.summary: The first Survivor to touch each totem gets it blocked, screams and shows up for you.
facts: It triggers the first time a Survivor interacts with each totem.
The Entity blocks that totem for 25 seconds, and you see it in white.
The Survivor screams.
You see that Survivor for 3/4/5 seconds.
killer:dominance.tip: Run it with Hex perks so every attempt to cleanse gives you a chase.

killer:dragons-grip.summary: After you kick a generator, the next Survivor who touches it screams and becomes Exposed.
facts: It is active for 30 seconds after you damage a generator.
The first Survivor who uses that generator screams and shows their location for 4 seconds.
That Survivor is Exposed for 60 seconds.
The cool-down is 60/45/30 seconds.
killer:dragons-grip.tip: Kick a generator and wait nearby for the Survivor who comes back to it.

killer:dying-light.summary: Hooking anyone but the Obsession slows the rest of the team, while the Obsession gets faster at rescues.
facts: You gain 1 Token for each hook on anyone other than the Obsession.
While the Obsession lives, the other Survivors repair, heal and sabotage 2/2.5/3% slower for each token.
The penalty stops at 22/27.5/33%, which is 11 Tokens.
The Obsession is not slowed and unhooks and heals others 33% faster.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:dying-light.tip: Leave the Obsession for last to keep the penalty running.

killer:enduring.summary: Pallet stuns hold you for a much shorter time, so the chase keeps going.
facts: Pallet stuns on you are 40/45/50% shorter.
It does not apply when you are stunned while carrying a Survivor.
killer:enduring.tip: Run it with Spirit Fury to punish Survivors who drop pallets early.

killer:eruption.summary: Generators you kick are marked, and each down makes them explode and shows the Survivors on them.
facts: Generators you damage are marked for you in yellow.
When any Survivor goes down, all marked generators explode and lose 10% of their total progress at once.
They then keep regressing.
Anyone repairing them screams, and you see them for 8/10/12 seconds.
The cool-down is 30 seconds after it fires, and the marks are cleared.
killer:eruption.tip: Kick many generators during chases so each down hits several at once.

killer:fire-up.summary: Each finished generator makes many of your actions faster, which helps you catch up late in the match.
facts: You gain 1 Token for each completed generator, up to 5 Tokens.
Each token makes the actions below 6/7/8% faster, up to 30/35/40%:
picking up and dropping Survivors,
breaking walls and dropped pallets,
damaging generators,
vaulting windows.
killer:fire-up.tip: It gets stronger as Survivors finish generators.

killer:forced-hesitation.summary: When a Survivor goes down, everyone near them is slowed, so rescues and escapes are harder.
facts: When a Survivor goes down in any way, other Survivors within 16 metres are Hindered by -20% for 10 seconds.
The cool-down is 40/35/30 seconds.
killer:forced-hesitation.tip: Down Survivors near their teammates to catch a second one quickly.

killer:forced-penance.summary: A Survivor who takes a protection hit for a teammate becomes Broken for a while.
facts: A Survivor who takes a Protection Hit is Broken for 60/70/80 seconds.
killer:forced-penance.tip: Hit the Survivor who body-blocks you. They cannot be healed afterwards.

killer:forever-entwined.summary: Each time a Survivor is hit, you get faster at picking up, dropping and hooking.
facts: You gain 1 Token each time a Survivor takes damage, up to 6/7/8 Tokens.
Each token makes you 4% faster at picking up, dropping and hooking Survivors, up to 24/28/32%.
killer:forever-entwined.tip: Faster pick-ups make flashlight and pallet saves harder.

killer:franklins-demise.summary: Your basic attacks knock items out of Survivors' hands, and you see the dropped items.
facts: A Survivor hit by your basic attack drops their item.
You see dropped items within 32/48/64 metres.
killer:franklins-demise.tip: Pick it against teams that rely on flashlights and Med-Kits.

killer:friends-til-the-end.summary: Hooking others exposes the Obsession, and hooking the Obsession picks a new Obsession.
facts: When you hook anyone but the Obsession, you see the Obsession for 6/8/10 seconds.
The Obsession is then Exposed for 20 seconds.
When you hook the Obsession, a random Survivor screams, shows their location and becomes the new Obsession.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:friends-til-the-end.tip: Go to the Obsession after each hook while they are Exposed.

killer:funny-business.summary: Kicking a generator gives you speed and one random extra effect, which can be good or bad.
facts: Each generator kick gives you +10% Haste for 10 seconds and one random effect.
The Haste can last 5 seconds longer.
You can be stunned for 2 seconds.
The generator can be blocked for 30 seconds.
The generator can spray confetti, which does nothing.
killer:funny-business.tip: Kick generators on your way to a chase to use the speed.

killer:furtive-chase.summary: Hooking the Obsession makes you fast and Undetectable, and their rescuer becomes the new Obsession.
facts: After you hook the Obsession, you are Undetectable and get +10% Haste for 14/16/18 seconds.
When another Survivor unhooks the Obsession, the rescuer becomes the Obsession.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:furtive-chase.tip: Chase the rescuer next, because they become the new Obsession.

killer:game-afoot.summary: Hitting the Survivor who has been chased longest makes them your Obsession, and breaking things while chasing them speeds you up.
facts: A basic attack on the Survivor with the most total chase time makes them the Obsession.
While you chase the Obsession, breaking or damaging something gives you +10% Haste for 8/9/10 seconds.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:game-afoot.tip: Run it with Brutal Strength to break pallets fast in chases.

killer:gearhead.summary: After a Survivor is hit, Good skill checks on generators show you who is repairing.
facts: It is active for 30 seconds after any Survivor loses a health state.
When a Survivor hits a Good repair skill check, you see them for 6/7/8 seconds.
killer:gearhead.tip: Hit a Survivor, then go to the generator it reveals for a new chase.

killer:genetic-limits.summary: A Survivor who loses a health state becomes Exhausted for a short time.
facts: Any Survivor who drops a health state becomes Exhausted for 6/7/8 seconds.
killer:genetic-limits.tip: It blocks Sprint Burst or Lithe right after you hit someone.

killer:grim-embrace.summary: First hooks on each Survivor block all generators briefly, and the fourth gives a long block.
facts: You gain 1 Token for each Survivor you hook for the first time.
It fires when you are 16 metres or more away from the hook.
With 1 to 3 Tokens, all generators are blocked for 6/8/10 seconds.
With 4 Tokens, all generators are blocked for 40 seconds and you see the Obsession for 6 seconds.
killer:grim-embrace.tip: Spread your hooks over all four Survivors for the full effect.

killer:haywire.summary: An Exit Gate that a Survivor leaves almost open starts closing again.
facts: If a Survivor stops opening a gate after it reaches 80% progress, the gate regresses.
It regresses at 80/90/100% of normal opening speed.
The lights on the switch flicker while it regresses.
killer:haywire.tip: Chase Survivors off the gate late, and the gate starts going back.

killer:help-wanted.summary: Generators you kick become compromised. When Survivors finish one, you recover faster and idle generators regress.
facts: Damaging a generator makes it Compromised. At most 3 generators are Compromised at once.
You see Compromised generators in yellow.
When a Compromised generator is completed, the effects below last 70/80/90 seconds.
You recover 25% faster after a hit with a basic attack.
Generators that nobody repairs regress at 150% of normal speed.
After that, no generator is Compromised any more.
killer:help-wanted.tip: Kick generators you cannot defend, so finishing them hurts the Survivors.

killer:hex-blood-favour.summary: A Hex that locks the pallets near a Survivor you hit, so nobody can drop them.
facts: A Hex Totem lights at the start of the match.
When a basic attack takes a health state, every pallet 32 metres or closer to that Survivor is blocked for 13/14/15 seconds.
No Survivor can drop a blocked pallet.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-blood-favour.tip: Hit Survivors near pallet loops so they have nowhere safe to run.

killer:hex-crowd-control.summary: A Hex that closes windows Survivors fast-vault, which shuts down strong loops.
facts: It lights on a random totem when a Survivor fast-vaults a window.
That window is blocked for all Survivors.
You vault blocked windows 15% faster.
You see blocked windows within 24 metres.
It can block 4/5/6 windows at a time.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-crowd-control.tip: Push Survivors to vault strong windows so those windows get blocked.

killer:hex-devour-hope.summary: A Hex that grows stronger each time a Survivor is rescued far from you, ending with kills by your own hand.
facts: A Hex Totem lights at the start of the match.
You gain 1 Token for each unhook that happens 24 metres or more away from you, up to 5 Tokens.
With 2 Tokens, you get 3/4/5% Haste for 10 seconds, starting 10 seconds after a hook.
With 3 Tokens, all Survivors are Exposed.
With 5 Tokens, you can kill downed Survivors yourself.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-devour-hope.tip: Leave the hook quickly so rescues happen far from you.

killer:hex-face-the-darkness.summary: Injuring a Survivor lights a Hex that makes everyone far from you scream and show up.
facts: It needs a Dull Totem on the map. When you injure a Survivor, it lights a Hex and curses that Survivor.
While that Survivor is cursed, every 35/30/25 seconds all other Survivors outside your Terror Radius scream.
You see them for 2 seconds.
It ends when the cursed Survivor is healed or goes down, and the totem goes out.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-face-the-darkness.tip: Keep the cursed Survivor injured so the screams keep coming.

killer:hex-fortunes-fool.summary: Your first hook on a Survivor lights a Hex that makes them Oblivious and protects the totem for a while.
facts: It needs a Dull Totem. Your first hook on a Survivor lights a Hex that curses them.
The cursed Survivor is Oblivious.
For 90 seconds no other Survivor can cleanse or bless the totem.
The cursed Survivor is not blocked from it.
The cursed Survivor sees the totem within 24/20/16 metres.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-fortunes-fool.tip: Patrol near the totem, because the cursed Survivor will try to cleanse it.

killer:hex-haunted-ground.summary: Two trap totems. Cleansing either one makes every Survivor Exposed for a while.
facts: 2 Hex Totems light when the match begins.
Blessing or cleansing either one makes all Survivors Exposed for 40/50/60 seconds.
The other Hex Totem goes out after the trap triggers.
It stops working for the rest of the match after it triggers.
killer:hex-haunted-ground.tip: Stay in a chase when the trap goes off to get a quick down.

killer:hex-hive-mind.summary: After your first hook you see how far each generator is, and the fourth finished generator punishes the rest.
facts: Your first hook turns a random Dull Totem into its Hex Totem, if a Dull Totem is left.
You see the generators, and brighter ones have more progress.
When 4 generators in total are completed, all other generators explode, lose 6/8/10% progress and start regressing.
The totem then becomes dull and the perk stops working for the match.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-hive-mind.tip: Use the brightness to defend the generators closest to completion.

killer:hex-huntress-lullaby.summary: A Hex that makes missed skill checks cost more and, with enough tokens, removes the skill check warning sound.
facts: Survivors who heal or repair lose 2/4/6% more progress on a missed skill check.
You gain 1 Token for each Survivor you hook, up to 5 Tokens.
The time between the warning sound and the skill check is 14% shorter with 1 Token, 28% with 2, 42% with 3 and 56% with 4.
With 5 Tokens there is no warning sound at all.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-huntress-lullaby.tip: Run it with skill check perks such as Overcharge or Unnerving Presence.

killer:hex-no-one-escapes-death.summary: When the gates get power, a Hex makes every Survivor Exposed and you slightly faster.
facts: When the Exit Gates get power, it lights a remaining Dull Totem.
You get 2/3/4% Haste.
All Survivors are Exposed.
Once Survivors are told about it, they see the totem within 4 metres, and that range grows to 24 metres over 30 seconds.
It does nothing if no Dull Totem is left.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-no-one-escapes-death.tip: Leave Dull Totems standing during the match so it has one to light.

killer:hex-nothing-but-misery.summary: After a few hits, a Hex lights that slows every Survivor you hit and makes them vault slower.
facts: Once you land 4 basic-attack hits in total, one random Dull Totem lights as its Hex and curses every Survivor.
A Survivor hit by a basic attack is Hindered by -5% for 10/12.5/15 seconds.
That Survivor also vaults 10% slower for 10/12.5/15 seconds.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-nothing-but-misery.tip: Keep chasing after a hit, because the Survivor cannot vault away as fast.

killer:hex-overture-of-doom.summary: A Hex curses the farthest generator. Survivors who work on it trigger your Terror Radius there while you sneak.
facts: The Hex Totem curses the generator farthest from it, and you see that generator in yellow.
When a Survivor repairs it for at least 5 seconds, the effects below last 20/25/30 seconds.
Your Terror Radius moves to that generator and is set to 32 metres.
You are Undetectable.
When that generator is done, the next farthest generator is cursed.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-overture-of-doom.tip: Go to the cursed generator while you are Undetectable to surprise the Survivors there.

killer:hex-pentimento.summary: You bring cleansed totems back to life to stack a heavy slowdown on healing and repairing.
facts: You see cleansed totems in white.
Press Interaction at a cleansed totem to make it a Rekindled Totem.
You gain 1 Token for each Rekindled Totem, up to 5 Tokens.
With 1 Token, healing and repairing are 20% slower.
With 2 to 5 Tokens, the penalty grows by 1/2/3% for each token, up to 24/28/32%.
Cursed Survivors see Rekindled Totems within 16 metres.
At 5 Tokens, all Rekindled Totems are blocked for the rest of the match.
Each totem can be rekindled once. A Rekindled Totem that is cleansed is gone for good.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-pentimento.tip: Rekindle totems whenever Survivors cleanse them, and stack tokens over the match.

killer:hex-plaything.summary: Your first hook on a Survivor lights a Hex that makes them Oblivious and protects the totem for a while.
facts: It needs a Dull Totem. Your first hook on a Survivor lights a Hex that curses them.
The cursed Survivor is Oblivious.
For 90 seconds no other Survivor can cleanse or bless the totem.
The cursed Survivor is not blocked from it.
The cursed Survivor sees the totem within 24/20/16 metres.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses the Hex Totem.
killer:hex-plaything.tip: Patrol near the totem, because the cursed Survivor will try to cleanse it.

killer:hex-retribution.summary: Survivors who use totems become Oblivious, and losing any Hex shows you the whole team.
facts: Any Survivor who cleanses or blesses a totem becomes Oblivious for 40/50/60 seconds.
When any Hex Totem is removed, this one included, you see all Survivors for 20 seconds.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.
killer:hex-retribution.tip: Run it with other Hex perks so every lost totem still gives you something.

killer:hex-ruin.summary: A Hex that makes every generator nobody is working on lose progress by itself.
facts: Generators that nobody repairs regress by themselves at 100/125/150% of the normal rate.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.
killer:hex-ruin.tip: Chase Survivors off generators so the regression can work.

killer:hex-scared-to-death.summary: After you hook three different Survivors, breaking a pallet in a chase makes nearby Survivors scream and slows them.
facts: It lights on a random Dull Totem once you have hooked 3 different Survivors.
When you break a pallet normally during a chase, Survivors within 13 metres scream.
They are Hindered by -11/-12/-13% for 3 seconds.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.
killer:hex-scared-to-death.tip: Break pallets quickly in chases to catch the slowed Survivor.

killer:hex-the-third-seal.summary: The last few Survivors you hit cannot see auras while the Hex stands.

killer:hex-the-third-seal.tip: Pick it against teams that rely on Kindred or Bond.

killer:hex-thrill-of-the-hunt.summary: Each lit Hex Totem adds a token, and each hook then blocks all totems for a while.

Each hook blocks all totems for 4/5/6 seconds for each token, up to 20/25/30 seconds.
You lose 1 Token when a Hex Totem is cleansed.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.

killer:hex-two-can-play.summary: After you are stunned or blinded a few times, a Hex blinds every Survivor who does it again.
facts: It lights on a random totem after Survivors stun or blind you 4/3/2 times.

Any Survivor who then stuns or blinds you is blinded for 1.5 seconds.
It does not affect a Survivor you are carrying.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.

killer:hex-under-your-thumb.summary: A Hex that caps how much Haste Survivors can get and shows you the ones who get it.
facts: It lights on a random Dull Totem when a Survivor gets a hook state.
Haste on running Survivors is capped at 25/20/15%.
When a running Survivor 32 metres or closer gains Haste, you see where they are for 4 seconds.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.
killer:hex-under-your-thumb.tip: Pick it against Sprint Burst and other speed perks.

killer:hex-undying.summary: It protects your other Hexes by moving them onto this totem when cleansed, and it shows Survivors near Dull Totems.
facts: Survivors who stand 2/3/4 metres or closer to a Dull Totem show to you while they stay that close.
When another Hex Totem is cleansed, that Hex moves to the Undying totem and replaces it.
It ends for good when a Survivor cleanses or blesses its Hex Totem.

killer:hex-wretched-fate.summary: After a generator is done, a Hex curses the Obsession and slows their repairs a lot.
facts: After a generator is completed, a random Dull Totem lights and curses the Obsession.
The Obsession repairs 27/30/33% slower.
The Obsession sees the Hex Totem within 12 metres.

killer:hoarder.summary: You hear Survivors who open chests or pick up items near you, and the map gets extra chests.

The match has 2 extra chests.
killer:hoarder.tip: Patrol areas with many chests early to catch looting Survivors.

killer:hubris.summary: Any Survivor who stuns you becomes Exposed for a while.
facts: When a Survivor stuns you in any way, they are Exposed for 20/25/30 seconds.
The cool-down is 20 seconds.
killer:hubris.tip: Chase the Survivor who stunned you right away for a quick down.

killer:human-greed.summary: You can close opened chests and see unopened ones, and Survivors near chests show up for you.
facts: You can kick opened chests to close them.
You always see unopened chests.
A Survivor who comes 8 metres or closer to a closed or unopened chest shows to you for 3/4/5 seconds.
The cool-down for kicking chests is 10 seconds.
killer:human-greed.tip: Close chests on your patrol to catch Survivors looking for items.

killer:hysteria.summary: When you injure a healthy Survivor, every injured Survivor becomes Oblivious for a while.
facts: When you injure a healthy Survivor, all injured Survivors are Oblivious for 30/35/40 seconds.
The Survivor you just hit is included.
The cool-down is 20 seconds.
killer:hysteria.tip: Spread injuries so many Survivors cannot hear you coming.

killer:im-all-ears.summary: A Survivor who fast-vaults near you is shown to you for several seconds.
facts: When a Survivor fast-vaults within 48 metres, you see them for 8 seconds.
The cool-down is 60/45/30 seconds.
killer:im-all-ears.tip: Use it to see which way a Survivor runs after a vault.

killer:insidious.summary: Standing still makes you Undetectable, and it stays for a few seconds after you move.
facts: After you stand still for 2 seconds, you are Undetectable while you do not move.
It stays for 6/7/8 seconds after you start moving.
killer:insidious.tip: Wait near a hook or a generator until Survivors come close.

killer:iron-grasp.summary: Carried Survivors push you around less and need longer to wiggle free.
facts: Their wiggling pushes you 75% less to the side.
Wiggling free takes 10/11/12% longer.
killer:iron-grasp.tip: It helps you reach far hooks or the Basement.

killer:iron-maiden.summary: You search lockers faster, and Survivors who leave a locker scream and become Exposed.
facts: You search empty lockers 30/40/50% faster.
A Survivor who leaves a locker screams, and you get a Loud Noise Notification there.
The notification stays for 4 seconds.
That Survivor is Exposed for 30 seconds.
killer:iron-maiden.tip: Pick it against Survivors who use Head On or Deception.

killer:keep-them-waiting.summary: Hitting Survivors other than the Obsession shortens your cool-down after hits, and hitting the Obsession costs tokens.

killer:kill-spree.summary: Once all generators are done and every Survivor has reached the second hook stage, you can kill Survivors yourself.

killer:knock-out.summary: A Survivor who drops a pallet and runs off quickly is slowed for a moment.

That Survivor is Hindered by -20% for 2/3/4 seconds.
killer:knock-out.tip: Stay at the pallet after the drop and catch the Survivor running off.

killer:languid-touch.summary: A Survivor who startles a crow near you becomes Exhausted.
facts: When a Survivor startles a crow within 36 metres, they are Exhausted for 6/8/10 seconds.
The cool-down is 5 seconds.
killer:languid-touch.tip: It blocks Survivors' sprint perks while you search for them.

killer:laughingstock.summary: Survivors near a completed generator are Exhausted and cannot hear your Terror Radius.
facts: Survivors who stand 12 metres or closer to a completed generator are Exhausted and Oblivious.

killer:lay-waste.summary: A generator you kick loses progress faster, and more so the further along it is.
facts: A generator you damage regresses 2% faster per charge of progress on it.
The cool-down is 55/50/45 seconds after a kick.
killer:lay-waste.tip: Kick generators that are almost done.

killer:lethal-pursuer.summary: You see all Survivors at the start, and every reveal of a Survivor lasts longer for you.
facts: At the start of the match you see all Survivors for 7/8/9 seconds.
Every reveal of a Survivor's aura to you lasts 2 seconds longer.

killer:lethal-pursuer.tip: Run it with other aura perks such as Barbecue & Chilli.

killer:leverage.summary: A Survivor who unhooks someone heals slower for a minute.
facts: After any unhook, the Survivor who did it heals 20/25/30% slower for 60 seconds.

killer:lightborn.summary: Most light sources cannot blind you, and you see the Survivors who try.
facts: A Survivor who tries to blind you shows to you for 6/8/10 seconds.

killer:machine-learning.summary: Generators you kick become compromised, and when Survivors finish one, you become fast and Undetectable.

killer:mad-grit.summary: While you carry a Survivor, missed attacks cost no time, and hits pause the carried Survivor's wiggling.

killer:make-your-choice.summary: A Survivor who rescues someone while you are far away screams and becomes Exposed.

The rescuer is Exposed for 40/50/60 seconds.
The cool-down is 40/50/60 seconds.
killer:make-your-choice.tip: Leave the hook quickly, then come back for the Exposed rescuer.

killer:merciless-storm.summary: Generators near completion give Survivors skill check after skill check, and one mistake blocks the generator.

killer:mindbreaker.summary: Survivors who repair generators are Blind and Exhausted, which shuts off their aura and sprint perks.

killer:monitor-and-abuse.summary: Your Terror Radius is smaller while you patrol and a little bigger while you chase.

killer:nemesis.summary: A Survivor who stuns or blinds you becomes your Obsession and cannot hear you for a while.

killer:no-holds-barred.summary: Each finished generator blocks the most advanced remaining generator for a short time.

killer:no-quarter.summary: A Survivor near the end of a self-heal gets skill check after skill check, and one mistake makes them Broken.

killer:no-way-out.summary: First hooks give tokens, and in the endgame the first touch on a gate switch blocks both switches for a while.

killer:none-are-free.summary: First hooks give tokens, and once all generators are done, windows and pallets are blocked for a while.

killer:none-are-free.tip: Down Survivors during the block, while they have nowhere to loop.

killer:nowhere-to-hide.summary: Kicking a generator shows you the Survivors hiding close to it.

killer:oppression.summary: Kicking one generator makes several others regress too and gives the Survivors on them a hard skill check.

killer:overcharge.summary: The next Survivor on a generator you kicked gets a hard skill check, and the regression speeds up over time.

killer:overcharge.tip: Kick generators that Survivors are about to come back to.

killer:overwhelming-presence.summary: Survivors who use items near you become Exhausted, and Exhausted Survivors near you show up.

The cool-down is 25 seconds.
killer:overwhelming-presence.tip: Pick it against teams that heal with Med-Kits and repair with Toolboxes.

killer:phantom-fear.summary: Survivors who look at you inside your Terror Radius scream and show up briefly.

You see that Survivor for 2 seconds.
The cool-down is 80/70/60 seconds.
killer:phantom-fear.tip: Walk toward Survivors from the front so they look at you.

killer:play-with-your-food.summary: Each time the Obsession escapes your chase, you get a speed token, and attacks use the tokens up.

killer:pop-goes-the-weasel.summary: After a hook, your next generator kick removes a large chunk of progress.

When you damage a generator by hand, it loses 15% more, so 20% in total.
It turns off after use or when the time runs out.
killer:pop-goes-the-weasel.tip: Hook Survivors near generators that are almost done.

killer:predator.summary: When a Survivor gets away from your chase, you see where they went for a moment.
facts: When a chased Survivor gets away from you, you see them for 4 seconds.
The cool-down is 60/50/40 seconds.
killer:predator.tip: It helps Killers who often lose Survivors around corners.

killer:rampage.summary: Breaking pallets and walls gives tokens, and the tokens give you speed after a stun or blind.

The cool-down is 30/25/20 seconds after a blind or stun while you have at least 1 token.

killer:rancor.summary: Each finished generator shows you where every Survivor is, and in the endgame you can kill the Obsession.

The Obsession sees you for 5/4/3 seconds.
When the Exit Gates get power, the Obsession stays Exposed until the match ends.
You can then kill the Obsession up close.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:rancor.tip: Keep the Obsession alive until the gates get power.

killer:rapid-brutality.summary: You never gain Bloodlust, but every hit gives you a short speed boost.
facts: You cannot gain Bloodlust.
A hit with a basic attack gives you +5% Haste for 8/9/10 seconds.
killer:rapid-brutality.tip: Use the speed to reach the next Survivor.

killer:ravenous.summary: First hooks give you speed while carrying and faster hooking, and the fourth makes everyone Exposed.
facts: You gain 1 Token for each Survivor you hook for the first time, up to 4 Tokens.
Each token gives you 4% Haste while you carry a Survivor and makes you hook 4% faster.
At 4 Tokens all Survivors scream and are Exposed for 80/85/90 seconds.
killer:ravenous.tip: Spread your hooks over all four Survivors to reach the Exposed effect.

killer:remember-me.summary: Each time you hurt the Obsession, the Exit Gates take longer to open for everyone else.

Each token adds 6 seconds to the time a gate takes to open, up to 18/24/30 seconds extra.
The gates then take up to 38/44/50 seconds to open.
The Obsession still opens gates in the normal 20 seconds.
You have only one Obsession at a time.
killer:remember-me.tip: Chase the Obsession during the match, but kill them last.

killer:save-the-best-for-last.summary: Hitting Survivors other than the Obsession shortens your cool-down after hits, and hitting the Obsession costs tokens.
facts: You gain 1 Token for each basic-attack hit on a Survivor who is not the Obsession, up to 6/7/8 Tokens.

killer:scourge-hook-gift-of-pain.summary: Survivors taken off a Scourge Hook bleed, and after their first full heal they work slower until they are hit again.

After their first full heal, they heal and repair 10/13/16% slower until they are injured again.
killer:scourge-hook-gift-of-pain.tip: Run it with healing slowdown so Survivors put off healing.

killer:scourge-hook-hangmans-trick.summary: While you carry a Survivor, you see Survivors near Scourge Hooks, and you hear hooks being sabotaged.
facts: At the start, 4 hooks become Scourge Hooks, and you see them in white.
While you carry a Survivor, you see every Survivor 12/14/16 metres or closer to a Scourge Hook.
When a Survivor starts to sabotage any hook, you get a Loud Noise Notification there.
killer:scourge-hook-hangmans-trick.tip: Pick it against teams that sabotage hooks.

killer:scourge-hook-jagged-compass.summary: Hooks that Survivors are rescued from turn into Scourge Hooks, and Scourge hooks show you the best generator.
facts: At the start, 4 hooks become Scourge Hooks, and you see them in white.
Any regular hook someone is rescued from turns into a Scourge Hook.
When you hook someone on a Scourge Hook, you see the most advanced generator in yellow for 6/8/10 seconds.
killer:scourge-hook-jagged-compass.tip: Use the generator reveal to defend the generator closest to completion.

killer:scourge-hook-monstrous-shrine.summary: The Basement hooks and some others become Scourge Hooks, and staying away from them speeds up regression.
facts: At the start, the 4 Basement hooks and 4 other hooks become Scourge Hooks.
You see Scourge Hooks in white.
While you stay over 24 metres away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, generators regress at 150/175/200% of normal speed.
killer:scourge-hook-monstrous-shrine.tip: Leave the hook after you hook someone to get the regression bonus.

killer:scourge-hook-pain-resonance.summary: The first Scourge hook on each Survivor makes the most advanced generator explode and lose progress.

Survivors working on it scream, but you get no Loud Noise Notification.
It stops working for the rest of the match once all tokens are spent.
killer:scourge-hook-pain-resonance.tip: Hook each Survivor on a Scourge Hook once to use all four tokens.

killer:scourge-hook-weeping-wounds.summary: Survivors taken off a Scourge Hook bleed, and after their first full heal they work slower until they are hit again.

killer:scourge-hook-weeping-wounds.tip: Run it with healing slowdown so Survivors put off healing.

killer:secret-project.summary: Totem cleanses and blessings block a generator, and any blocked generator makes you Undetectable.
facts: Each cleanse or blessing of a totem blocks one random unblocked generator for 20/25/30 seconds.
Whenever generators become blocked, you are Undetectable for 30 seconds.

killer:see-how-they-run.summary: Each time the Obsession escapes your chase, you get a speed token, and attacks use the tokens up.
facts: You gain 1 Token when you lose the Obsession in a chase, up to 3 Tokens.

Both effects stay for 20/25/30 seconds after the heal stops.
killer:septic-touch.tip: Interrupt heals to block their exhaustion perks for a long time.

killer:shadowborn.summary: Being blinded gives you a short speed boost.
facts: When you are blinded in any way, you get 6/8/10% Haste for 10 seconds.
killer:shadowborn.tip: Catch the flashlight Survivor right after the blind.

killer:shattered-hope.summary: You destroy Boon Totems instead of snuffing them, and every totem action blocks all totems for a while.
facts: You destroy Boon Totems instead of snuffing them.
Each totem cleanse, blessing or destruction blocks every totem for 16/18/20 seconds.
You also see all blessed totems for 16/18/20 seconds.
killer:shattered-hope.tip: Pick it against teams that run several Boon perks.

killer:silent-shadow.summary: Each hook makes you Undetectable for a short time, and once the gates have power you stay Undetectable.
facts: Each hook makes you Undetectable for 11/12/13 seconds.
When the Exit Gates get power, you stay Undetectable until the match ends.
killer:silent-shadow.tip: Use the time after a hook to surprise the Survivors who come for the rescue.

killer:sloppy-butcher.summary: Your hits make Survivors bleed heavily and heal slower for more than a minute.

Their unfinished heal progress drops 25% faster.
killer:sloppy-butcher.tip: Run it with A Nurse's Calling to find Survivors who try to heal.

killer:spies-from-the-shadows.summary: Crows that Survivors startle near you warn you with a special sound.

killer:spirit-fury.summary: After you break a few pallets, the next pallet that stuns you breaks at once.

The stun still lasts as long as usual.

killer:stridor.summary: Survivors' grunts of pain and breathing are louder, so you can find them by sound.

killer:superior-anatomy.summary: When a Survivor fast-vaults near you, your own vaults get much faster for a short time.

facts: A damaged generator shows in white while it regresses.
It shows in yellow when a Survivor has stopped the regression.
The yellow lasts 8/12/16 seconds, then the normal colour returns.
Repair noises carry 8 metres further.
killer:surveillance.tip: Kick generators, then go back to the ones that turn yellow.

killer:terminus.summary: In the endgame, injured, downed and hooked Survivors become Broken and cannot be healed.
facts: It activates when the Exit Gates get power.
Injured, downed and hooked Survivors become Broken.
It lasts until a gate is opened, then for another 35/40/45 seconds.
killer:terminus.tip: Run it with No Way Out or Blood Warden for strong endgame pressure.

killer:territorial-imperative.summary: A Survivor who goes down into the Basement while you are far from it shows up for you.
facts: If a Survivor goes into the Basement while you are over 24 metres from its entrance, you see them for 4/5/6 seconds.
The cool-down is 45 seconds.
killer:territorial-imperative.tip: Hook Survivors in the Basement to catch the rescuers coming down.

killer:thanatophobia.summary: Each hurt, downed or hooked Survivor slows the whole team's work a little.
facts: It is active while at least one Survivor is injured, downed or hooked.
All Survivors cleanse, repair and sabotage 1/1.5/2% slower for each such Survivor, up to 4/6/8%.
If all four are injured, downed or hooked, the penalty grows by 12% to 16/18/20%.
killer:thanatophobia.tip: Spread injuries instead of focusing on one Survivor.

killer:thrilling-tremors.summary: When you pick up a Survivor, all generators nobody is working on are blocked for a short time.
facts: When you pick up a Survivor, generators that nobody repairs are blocked for 16 seconds.
You see the blocked generators in white.
The cool-down is 40/35/30 seconds.
killer:thrilling-tremors.tip: Generators that are not blocked have Survivors on them.

killer:thwack.summary: Breaking walls and pallets makes nearby Survivors scream and show up, using tokens.
facts: You start the match with 3 Tokens.
Breaking a wall or dropped pallet uses 1 Token.
Survivors within 36 metres then scream, and you see them for 4/5/6 seconds.
You gain 1 Token each time you hook a Survivor.
killer:thwack.tip: Break pallets near generators to find the Survivors working there.

killer:tinkerer.summary: A generator that reaches 70% alerts you, and you become Undetectable for a while.
facts: When a generator reaches 70%, you get a Loud Noise Notification there.
You are Undetectable for 12/14/16 seconds.
It works once per generator per match.
killer:tinkerer.tip: Go straight to that generator to surprise the Survivors on it.

killer:trail-of-torment.summary: Kicking a generator makes you Undetectable until it stops regressing, but Survivors see the generator.
facts: When you damage a generator, you become Undetectable.
All Survivors see that generator in yellow.
It ends when that generator stops regressing.
The cool-down is 60/45/30 seconds.
killer:trail-of-torment.tip: Kick a generator, then sneak to another area while you are Undetectable.

killer:turn-back-the-clock.summary: After a hook, you can press a button to make a nearby generator explode and regress.
facts: For 40/50/60 seconds after a hook, press Active Ability to target a generator within 20 metres.
That generator explodes, loses 10% progress and starts regressing.
killer:turn-back-the-clock.tip: Hook Survivors near generators so you can use it right away.

killer:ultimate-weapon.summary: Opening a locker makes Survivors near it scream, show their location and lose aura reading.
facts: When you search a locker, it affects every Survivor 40 metres or closer to it.
They scream and show their location.
They are Blind for 30 seconds.
The cool-down is 55/50/45 seconds.
killer:ultimate-weapon.tip: Open a locker on your way across the map to find Survivors.

killer:unbound.summary: After a Survivor gets injured, vaulting windows gives you a small speed boost.
facts: When a Survivor becomes injured, it is active for 26/28/30 seconds.
Vaulting a window then gives you +5% Haste for 25 seconds.
It does not stack with itself.
killer:unbound.tip: It suits Killers who chase through window loops.

killer:undone.summary: Hooks give tokens that you spend on a kick to make a generator lose progress and block it.
facts: You gain 1 Token for each hook, up to 1/2/3 Tokens.
Damaging a generator uses all tokens.
The generator loses 10% for each token, up to 10/20/30%.
It is blocked for 10 seconds for each token, up to 10/20/30 seconds.
When the block ends, it starts regressing.
killer:undone.tip: Save the tokens for a generator that is almost done.

killer:unforeseen.summary: Kicking a generator moves your Terror Radius there while you become Undetectable.
facts: After you damage a generator, the effects below last 22/26/30 seconds.
Your Terror Radius moves to that generator and is set to 32 metres.
You are Undetectable.
The cool-down is 30 seconds.
killer:unforeseen.tip: Survivors run away from the generator, often straight toward you.

killer:unnerving-presence.summary: Survivors who work inside your Terror Radius get more skill checks, and those checks are harder.
facts: Inside your Terror Radius, Survivors who repair or heal get skill checks 10% more often.
The Good zone of those checks is 40/50/60% smaller.
killer:unnerving-presence.tip: Run it with Overcharge or Huntress Lullaby.

killer:unrelenting.summary: You recover faster after missed and successful basic attacks.
facts: You recover from a missed basic attack 30/35/40% faster.
You recover from a hit 10% faster.
killer:unrelenting.tip: It suits Killers who often miss swings around loops.

killer:wandering-eye.summary: When a chase starts, you see other injured Survivors close to you.
facts: When a chase starts, you see every other injured Survivor 20 metres or closer to you for 5 seconds.
The cool-down is 40/35/30 seconds.
killer:wandering-eye.tip: Switch to an injured Survivor if they are closer.

killer:weave-attunement.summary: Items that run out are dropped and shown to you, together with Survivors near them.
facts: An item that runs out for the first time is dropped automatically.
You see dropped Survivor items, and every Survivor 12 metres or closer to one.
Those Survivors see the item too.
A Survivor who picks up a Survivor item is Oblivious for 20/25/30 seconds.
killer:weave-attunement.tip: Watch the dropped items, because Survivors often come back for them.

killer:whispers.summary: You hear whispers when a Survivor is near you, and you move faster when none are.
facts: The Entity whispers to you whenever a Survivor is 28/26/24 metres or closer.
With nobody inside that 28/26/24 metre range, you get +5% Haste.
killer:whispers.tip: Use the whispers to find Survivors hiding around you.

killer:zanshin-tactics.summary: You see nearby pallets and windows, and a Survivor who drops a pallet shows up for you.
facts: You see pallets and windows within 32 metres.
When a Survivor drops a pallet, you see them for 3/4/5 seconds.
killer:zanshin-tactics.tip: Use it to learn loops and to avoid wasting time at strong pallets.

survivor:a-place-for-us.summary: Healing a teammate makes you both Elusive, and finishing a heal on the Obsession keeps you both Elusive longer.
facts: While you heal another Survivor, you and that Survivor are Elusive.
After a full heal on the Obsession, you and the Obsession stay Elusive for 20/25/30 seconds.
Your chance to start as the Obsession drops by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:a-place-for-us.tip: Heal the Obsession first when you can, because that heal gives the long Elusive window.

survivor:ace-in-the-hole.summary: Items you take from chests come with add-ons, and you keep the add-ons on your item when you escape.
facts: Regular items you take from a chest get 1 to 2 add-ons.
The first add-on slot is filled 100% of the time, with Visceral rarity or lower.
The second add-on slot is filled 50/75/100% of the time, with Uncommon rarity or lower.
When you escape, the add-ons on the item you hold are not used up.
survivor:ace-in-the-hole.tip: Run it with Plunderer's Instinct to find chests quickly and get better items.

survivor:adrenaline.summary: When the Exit Gates get power, you heal one health state and sprint, even while Exhausted.
facts: It fires on its own when the Exit Gates get power.
It heals you by one health state.
You get +50% Haste for 4 seconds.
It works while you are Exhausted, and a status effect you already have does not block it.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 seconds.
survivor:adrenaline.tip: Stay injured near the end of the match so the free heal counts.

survivor:aftercare.summary: You and the teammates who rescued or healed you, or whom you rescued or healed, see each other.
facts: You see the auras of your 1/2/3 most recent linked Survivors.
A link forms when one of you rescues the other from a hook or finishes healing the other.
Linked Survivors see your aura too.
The list is cleared when the Killer hooks you.
survivor:aftercare.tip: In solo queue it shows you which teammate can come and heal you.

survivor:alert.summary: Each time the Killer kicks a generator or breaks something, you see where they are.
facts: It triggers when the Killer does a Break or Damage action.
You see the Killer's aura for 3/4/5 seconds.
survivor:alert.tip: Watch which way the Killer walks after a kick to decide whether to leave your generator.

survivor:any-means-necessary.summary: You see dropped pallets and can lift them back up.
facts: You see the auras of pallets that have been dropped.
Hold Active Ability next to a dropped pallet to stand it up again.
Lifting it takes 5/4/3 seconds.
survivor:any-means-necessary.tip: Lift pallets at your strongest loop while the Killer chases someone else.

survivor:apocalyptic-ingenuity.summary: After you open a chest, you can rebuild a broken pallet as a pallet that breaks on its first drop.
facts: You see the spots of broken pallets within 24/28/32 metres.
The ability unlocks after you open or rummage through 1 chest.
At a broken pallet spot, hold Active Ability for 3 seconds to rebuild it.
The rebuilt pallet is Fragile and breaks as soon as it is dropped.
survivor:apocalyptic-ingenuity.tip: Rebuild pallets at your best loops. A Fragile pallet still stuns the Killer once.

survivor:appraisal.summary: You rummage faster and can take an extra item from a chest someone already opened.
facts: You start the match with 4 Tokens.
Hold Interaction at an opened, empty chest to rummage through it.
Each rummage gives you one extra item and uses 1 Token. You can rummage a chest at most twice.
You rummage 40/60/80% faster.
survivor:appraisal.tip: Run it with Ace in the Hole so the extra items come with add-ons.

survivor:autodidact.summary: Skill checks you hit while healing teammates add tokens, and Good checks then add more healing.
facts: Each skill check you pass while healing another Survivor adds 1 Token, up to 3/4/5 Tokens.
Great healing skill checks no longer appear.
With 0 Tokens a Good check gives -15% progress. With 1 Token it gives +0%, with 2 Tokens +15% and with 3 Tokens +30%.
With 4 Tokens a Good check gives +45%, and with 5 Tokens it gives +60%.
Tier I stops at 3 Tokens, tier II at 4 and tier III at 5.
It does nothing when you heal with a Med-Kit.
survivor:autodidact.tip: Heal teammates early so the tokens are stacked when heals matter later.

survivor:babysitter.summary: When you unhook someone, you see the Killer and the rescued Survivor gets away faster without a trail.
facts: When you unhook another Survivor, you see the Killer's aura for 8 seconds.
For 20/25/30 seconds, the rescued Survivor leaves no Scratch Marks or blood.
Their Haste is 10% stronger for that time.
survivor:babysitter.tip: Tell your team whether the Killer is camping or walking away.

survivor:background-player.summary: When the Killer picks up a teammate, you can sprint toward them for a save.
facts: It is ready for 10 seconds after the Killer picks up another downed Survivor.
If you start running in that time, you get +50% Haste for 5 seconds.
It does not work while you are Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 30/25/20 seconds.
survivor:background-player.tip: Stay near the chase so the sprint gets you to a pallet or a flashlight save.

survivor:bada-bada-boom.summary: After some generator work you can trap a window, and the Killer is slowed when they vault it.
facts: It activates after 20% of generator repairs.
Press Active Ability at a window to set a trap that lasts up to 40/50/60 seconds.
If the Killer vaults that window, they are Hindered by -50% for 6 seconds.
It turns off after the trap goes off or the time runs out.
All Survivors see trapped windows in yellow.
survivor:bada-bada-boom.tip: Trap the window at the loop you plan to run next.

survivor:balanced-landing.summary: Dropping from a height is silent and gives you a short sprint.
facts: When you fall from a height, falling and landing make no noise.
The stagger after landing is 75% shorter.
You get +50% Haste for 3 seconds after the drop.
It does not work while you are Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 seconds.
survivor:balanced-landing.tip: Lead chases over ledges and stairs so each drop gives you the sprint.

survivor:bardic-inspiration.summary: You perform and roll a d20, and nearby teammates get extra progress from skill checks.
facts: Stand still and press Active Ability to perform for up to 15 seconds.
The performance affects other Survivors within 16 metres.
A d20 roll decides the bonus, which lasts 90 seconds after the performance.
On a 1 you scream, but the Killer gets no notification.
On 2 to 10, skill checks give +1% progress.
On 11 to 19, skill checks give +2% progress.
On a 20, skill checks give +3% progress.
The cool-down is 110/100/90 seconds after you finish or cancel.
survivor:bardic-inspiration.tip: Perform in a quiet corner while teammates work on generators.

survivor:best-gift-ever.summary: You give items to the Entity, and each item type you give unlocks its own bonus.
facts: You start the match with 4/5/6 Tokens.
The first time you drop each item type, you spend 1 Token, the Entity takes the item and you get that item's bonus.
Flashlight bonus. A Killer you stun is blinded for 2 seconds.
Fog Vial bonus. After a fast vault, your Scratch Marks fade 50% faster for 5 seconds.
Key bonus. You can rummage through each chest once.
Map bonus. Auras you see stay +1 second longer.
Med-Kit bonus. When you heal a Survivor, you also heal yourself at 25% speed.
Toolbox bonus. You see the auras of the 3 nearest generators.
survivor:best-gift-ever.tip: Open chests early and drop spare items to collect several bonuses.

survivor:better-than-new.summary: Teammates you heal do several actions faster until they are hit again.
facts: After you finish healing another Survivor, they bless, cleanse, heal and unlock faster.
The bonus is 40/45/50%.
It lasts until they take damage.
survivor:better-than-new.tip: Heal the teammate who will cleanse totems or open the gate next.

survivor:better-together.summary: The team sees the generator you repair, and you see everyone when a teammate goes down.
facts: While you repair, all Survivors see that generator in yellow.
If a teammate is downed while you repair, you see all Survivors for 20/25/30 seconds.
survivor:better-together.tip: Use the reveal after a down to see who is already going for the save.

survivor:bite-the-bullet.summary: Healing makes no noise, and a missed healing skill check costs less.
facts: When you heal yourself or others, healing makes no noise and you make no Grunts of Pain.
A missed healing skill check gives the Killer no Loud Noise Notification.
A missed check costs only 3/2/1% of total progress.
survivor:bite-the-bullet.tip: Run it with a self-heal perk against Killers who listen for grunts.

survivor:blast-mine.summary: After some repairs you can trap a generator, and the Killer is stunned and blinded when they kick it.
facts: It activates after repairs worth 40% of a generator.
Press Active Ability at a generator to set a trap with a timer of 100/110/120 seconds.
The trap goes off halfway through the Killer's kick.
The Killer is stunned for 4 seconds, and every player within 12.5 metres is blinded.
The trap ends when it goes off or the timer runs out.
All Survivors see trapped generators in yellow.
survivor:blast-mine.tip: Trap the generator the Killer kicks most, then move away so you are not blinded.

survivor:blood-pact.summary: Once you or the Obsession is hurt, you see each other and get faster after healing each other.
facts: It activates when you or the Obsession gets injured.
You and the Obsession always see each other's aura.
When one of you heals the other, you both get 5/6/7% Haste.
The Haste lasts while you stay within 16 metres of each other.
If you are the Obsession and get hooked, another Survivor becomes the Obsession.
Your chance to start as the Obsession drops by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:blood-pact.tip: Stay close to the Obsession after a heal to keep the Haste.

survivor:blood-rush.summary: After an unhook you can clear your Exhaustion once, so your sprint perk is ready again.
facts: It is active for 40/50/60 seconds after you are unhooked in any way.
Press Active Ability to remove Exhaustion at once.
It does not make you Exhausted.
A Conspicuous Action turns it off early.
It turns off after one use, and it stops working for the rest of the match once the Exit Gates get power.
survivor:blood-rush.tip: Run it with Sprint Burst or Lithe to use that perk twice after an unhook.

survivor:boil-over.summary: While carried, your wiggling pushes the Killer around more and hides nearby hooks from them.
facts: While the Killer carries you, your wiggling pushes them 60/70/80% harder.
The Killer cannot see hooks within 16 metres of you.
If the Killer drops from a height, you gain +33% of your current wiggle progress.
survivor:boil-over.tip: Wiggle toward drops and areas without hooks to give teammates time.

facts: You see the auras of other Survivors within 20/28/36 metres.
survivor:bond.tip: Use it to find a teammate for a shared generator or a heal.

survivor:boon-circle-of-healing.summary: You bless a totem, and Survivors near it heal others faster and see injured teammates.
facts: Hold Active Ability at a Dull or Hex Totem. It becomes a Boon Totem.
The boon reaches 24 metres, and Survivors in range hear chimes.
Survivors in range heal others 50/75/100% faster when they do not use a Med-Kit.
Every injured Survivor shows to the other Survivors.
Only one Circle of Healing can affect a Survivor at a time.
All your Boon perks share one blessed totem.
survivor:boon-circle-of-healing.tip: Bless a totem near the middle of the map so the team can heal there.

survivor:boon-dark-theory.summary: You bless a totem, and Survivors near it move a little faster.
facts: Hold Active Ability at a Dull or Hex Totem. It becomes a Boon Totem.
The boon reaches 24 metres, and Survivors in range hear chimes.
Survivors in range get +3% Haste.
The Haste stays for 2/3/4 seconds after they leave the range.
All your Boon perks share one blessed totem.
survivor:boon-dark-theory.tip: Bless a totem next to a strong loop so the speed helps in chases.

survivor:boon-exponential.summary: You bless a totem, and downed Survivors near it can get up by themselves.
facts: Hold Active Ability at a Dull or Hex Totem. It becomes a Boon Totem.
The boon reaches 24 metres, and Survivors in range hear chimes.
Downed Survivors in range recover 90/95/100% faster.
They can pick themselves up from the Dying State without help.
All your Boon perks share one blessed totem.
survivor:boon-exponential.tip: After a down, crawl into the boon range instead of waiting for a teammate.

survivor:boon-illumination.summary: You bless a totem, and Survivors near it see all chests and generators. You also bless faster.
facts: Hold Active Ability at a Dull or Hex Totem. It becomes a Boon Totem.
The boon reaches 24 metres, and Survivors in range hear chimes.
Survivors in range see all chests and generators in blue.
While your Boon Totem is lit, you bless 150/175/200% faster.
Only one Illumination can affect a Survivor at a time.
All your Boon perks share one blessed totem.
survivor:boon-illumination.tip: The fast blessing lets you relight your boons quickly after the Killer snuffs them.

survivor:boon-shadow-step.summary: You bless a totem, and the Killer cannot track Survivors near it by Scratch Marks or auras.
facts: Hold Active Ability at a Dull or Hex Totem. It becomes a Boon Totem.
The boon reaches 24 metres, and Survivors in range hear chimes.
Survivors in range leave no Scratch Marks.
The Killer cannot see the auras of Survivors in range.
Both effects stay for 2/3/4 seconds after a Survivor leaves the range.
survivor:boon-shadow-step.tip: Run a chase through the boon range and turn a corner to lose the Killer.

survivor:boon-steadfast.summary: You bless a totem, and generators near it regress slower and repair faster.
facts: Hold Active Ability at a Dull or Hex Totem. It becomes a Boon Totem.
The boon reaches 24 metres, and Survivors in range hear chimes.
Generators in range regress 50% slower.
Survivors repair those generators 8/9/10% faster.
Survivors in range see those generators.
Only one Steadfast can affect a Survivor at a time.
All your Boon perks share one blessed totem.
survivor:boon-steadfast.tip: Bless a totem that sits between two or three generators.

survivor:borrowed-time.summary: The teammate you unhook gets longer Endurance and Haste, so a hit right after the rescue does not down them.
facts: When you unhook another Survivor, their Endurance lasts 6/8/10 seconds longer, 16/18/20 seconds in total.
Any Conspicuous Action ends that Endurance early.
Their Haste lasts 10 seconds longer, 20 seconds in total.
survivor:borrowed-time.tip: Unhook when the Killer is close. The rescued Survivor should run, not repair.

facts: Your healing is always 30/40/50% faster.
survivor:botany-knowledge.tip: It stacks with Med-Kits and healing boons.

survivor:bound-by-obsession.summary: While the Killer reads your aura, you see them and work faster.
facts: It triggers each time the Killer reads your aura and lasts as long as that reading.
During it you see the Killer.
During it you cleanse, heal and repair 8/9/10% faster.
If you are the current Obsession, the Killer sees you for 4 seconds every 30 seconds.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:bound-by-obsession.tip: Pick it against Killers with aura perks. As the Obsession you will be found more often.

survivor:breakdown.summary: The hook you are taken off breaks, and you briefly see the Killer.
facts: It triggers when you are unhooked in any way.
That hook breaks at once.
The hook takes 180 seconds to come back.
You see the Killer's aura for 4/5/6 seconds.
survivor:breakdown.tip: Stay near the broken hook so the Killer has to carry you further next time.

survivor:breakout.summary: When you stay close to the Killer while they carry a teammate, you run faster and your teammate wiggles faster.
facts: It works while you are within 5 metres of a Killer who carries a teammate.
You get 6/8/10% Haste.
The carried Survivor wiggles 25% faster.
Only one Breakout can affect a Survivor at a time.
survivor:breakout.tip: Body-block in front of the Killer to steer them away from hooks.

survivor:buckle-up.summary: While you pick up a downed teammate, you both see the Killer, and they run off fast without a trail.
facts: It triggers when you heal a Survivor who is in the Dying State.
During the heal, you and the downed Survivor see the Killer.
After the heal, the healed Survivor leaves no Scratch Marks for 3/4/5 seconds.
For that time they also get +50% Haste.
Nobody becomes Exhausted from it.
survivor:buckle-up.tip: Watch the Killer's aura and finish the pick-up when they are far away.

survivor:built-to-last.summary: You hide in a locker with an empty item to refill it, up to three times per match.
facts: Hide in a locker for 12/10/8 seconds while you hold a depleted item.
The first refill brings the item to 99%.
The second refill brings it to 66%.
The third refill brings it to 33%.
It stops working for the rest of the match after the third refill.
survivor:built-to-last.tip: Bring a strong Med-Kit or Toolbox that you want to use more than once.

survivor:calm-spirit.summary: You stay quiet. Crows stay put, you never scream, and chests and totems make no noise.
facts: Nearby crows only fly off when you almost touch them.
You never scream, whatever the cause.
Chests and totems make no noise when you use them.
You bless, cleanse and unlock 8/9/10% faster.
survivor:calm-spirit.tip: It counters Killers who use scream perks such as Infectious Fright.

survivor:camaraderie.summary: When you struggle on a hook and a teammate comes close, your struggle timer pauses.
facts: It works once you reach the Struggle Phase on a hook.
A teammate who gets 16 metres or closer to your hook pauses the timer for 26/30/34 seconds.
survivor:camaraderie.tip: Teammates should come close early, because the pause gives them time for a safe rescue.

survivor:champion-of-light.summary: You run faster while your flashlight is on, and the Killer is slowed after you blind them.
facts: While your flashlight is on, you get +50% Haste.
When you blind the Killer in any way, they are Hindered by -20% for 6 seconds.
The Hindered effect does not stack.
The cool-down is 60/50/40 seconds after a blind.
survivor:champion-of-light.tip: Blind the Killer when they are close behind you, then run to the next loop.

survivor:change-of-plan.summary: Inside a locker you can swap your Toolbox for an equally rare Med-Kit.
facts: You start the match with 2 Tokens.
Inside a locker, hold a regular Toolbox and press Active Ability to spend 1 Token.
You get a Med-Kit of equal rarity, plus one random add-on of equal rarity.
That Med-Kit starts with 80/90/100% charges.
survivor:change-of-plan.tip: Repair with the Toolbox early, and switch to a Med-Kit after your first hit.

survivor:chemical-trap.summary: After some generator work you can trap a dropped pallet, and the Killer is slowed when they break it.
facts: It activates after 20% of generator repairs in total.
Press Active Ability at a dropped pallet to set a trap that lasts 40/50/60 seconds.
When the Killer breaks that pallet, the trap goes off.
The Killer is Hindered by -50% for 4 seconds.
It turns off after the trap goes off or the time runs out.
All Survivors see trapped pallets in yellow.
survivor:chemical-trap.tip: Trap the pallet you just dropped in a chase so the break costs the Killer time.

survivor:clairvoyance.summary: Once you have cleansed or blessed a totem, you can stand still and see key objects in a wide area.
facts: It activates when you cleanse or bless any totem.
Hold Use Item with empty hands to use it.
You see chests, Exit Gate switches, generators, the Hatch and hooks within 64 metres.
It lasts while you hold the button, up to 10/11/12 seconds.
survivor:clairvoyance.tip: Use it late in the match to find the Hatch or the nearest gate.

survivor:clean-break.summary: After you heal a teammate, you can take Broken to get an automatic heal later.
facts: It activates after you finish healing another Survivor.
Press Active Ability while a teammate heals you.
You become Broken.
After 75/60/45 seconds you heal 1 health state by yourself.
Going down cancels it.
It does not activate if you are already Broken.
It turns off after it heals you.
survivor:clean-break.tip: Use it when there is no time for a full heal and you want to repair.

survivor:come-and-get-me.summary: After a rescue you can scream to draw the Killer to you while injured teammates leave no traces.
facts: It works after you unhook a Survivor, while you crouch and stand still.
Press Active Ability to use it.
For 10/12.5/15 seconds, injured or downed Survivors within 24 metres make no grunts and leave no blood or Scratch Marks.
You scream, and the Killer sees your aura for 5 seconds.
survivor:come-and-get-me.tip: Use it right after the unhook so the rescued Survivor gets away cleanly.

survivor:conviction.summary: After you have healed someone, you can get up from the Dying State by yourself for a short time.
facts: It needs one finished heal on another Survivor first.
When you are down and your recovery reaches 25%, press Active Ability.
You can then fully recover by yourself.
You become Broken.
After 20/25/30 seconds you go back into the Dying State.
survivor:conviction.tip: Use the time on your feet to reach a teammate who can heal you.

survivor:corrective-action.summary: When a teammate misses a skill check, you turn it into a Good one.
facts: You start with 1/2/3 Tokens. Each Great skill check you hit adds 1 Token, up to 5.
When another Survivor misses a skill check, it counts as a Good one instead.
Each save uses 1 Token.
You then see that Survivor's aura for 6 seconds.
It does not cover special skill checks.
survivor:corrective-action.tip: Repair with teammates who miss skill checks, so the generator does not explode.

survivor:counterforce.summary: You cleanse totems much faster, faster again after each one, and you see the farthest totem.
facts: Your base cleansing speed is always 125%.
Each totem you cleanse adds 25% cleansing speed, and the bonus stacks.
After a cleanse you see the farthest totem for 10/12/14 seconds.
survivor:counterforce.tip: Pick it against Hex builds and cleanse totems early.

survivor:cross-examination.summary: Inside the Terror Radius you see the trail the Killer leaves, and standing on it makes you Elusive.
facts: It works inside the Terror Radius while nobody chases you.
You see the Light Marks the Killer leaves while moving. Each mark lasts 10 seconds.
While you stand on a Light Mark, you are Elusive.
Elusive stays for 3/4/5 seconds after you step off.
survivor:cross-examination.tip: Walk along the Killer's recent path to hide from their aura perks.

survivor:cut-loose.summary: Fast vaults in a chase are silent for a short time, and each new fast vault resets the timer.
facts: A fast vault during a chase activates it for 4/5/6 seconds.
Fast vaults make no noise and give the Killer no Loud Noise Notification.
Each new fast vault while it is active resets the timer.
The cool-down is 45 seconds after it ends.
survivor:cut-loose.tip: Chain windows that are close together to lose the Killer.

survivor:dance-with-me.summary: A fast window vault or fast locker exit hides your Scratch Marks for a moment.
facts: It triggers on a fast window vault or a fast exit from a locker.
You leave no Scratch Marks for 5 seconds.
The cool-down is 20/20/15 seconds.
survivor:dance-with-me.tip: Vault, then turn a corner at once to break line of sight.

survivor:dark-sense.summary: After a generator is done, the Killer coming close shows you the Killer, your teammates, and nearby pallets and windows.
facts: It arms each time a generator is completed.
When the Killer comes within 24 metres of you, it triggers for 13/14/15 seconds.
You see the Killer and the other Survivors.
Windows and pallets up to 32 metres away show too.
It turns off after use until the next generator.
survivor:dark-sense.tip: Use the pallet and window auras to plan your escape route.

survivor:dead-hard.summary: After an unhook you can dash to get a split second of Endurance and take a hit.
facts: It unlocks after you are unhooked in any way.
Press Active Ability while injured and running.
You get Endurance for 0.5 seconds.
It does not work while you are Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 seconds.
survivor:dead-hard.tip: Press it just before the hit lands. Too early wastes it.

survivor:deadline.summary: When you are injured, skill checks come more often and in random spots, but a miss costs less.
facts: It is active while you are injured.
Skill checks are 6/8/10% more likely while you repair or heal.
Skill checks appear anywhere on the screen.
A missed skill check costs 50% less.
survivor:deadline.tip: Run it with Hyperfocus or Stake Out.

survivor:deception.summary: You fake a locker entry so the Killer looks in the wrong place while you run off.
facts: Hold Sprint while you use a locker.
You run past the locker instead of getting in.
The doors open and close as if you jumped in.
The Killer gets a Loud Noise Notification at the locker.
You leave no Scratch Marks or blood for 5 seconds.
The cool-down is 25/20/15 seconds.
survivor:deception.tip: Use a locker next to a corner or tall cover so the Killer cannot see you leave.

survivor:decisive-strike.summary: After an unhook you can stab the Killer once to escape their grip.
facts: It is active for 40/50/60 seconds after you are unhooked or unhook yourself.
When the Killer grabs you or picks you up, hit a skill check to break free.
The Killer is stunned for 4 seconds.
You become the next Obsession.
It turns off when the Exit Gates get power.
You can use it once per match.
A Conspicuous Action turns it off early.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:decisive-strike.tip: Do not repair or heal right after the unhook, or it turns off.

survivor:deja-vu.summary: You see the three generators closest to each other and repair them a little faster.
facts: You see the 3 generators that stand closest to each other.
You repair those generators 4/5/6% faster.
survivor:deja-vu.tip: Finish those generators early so the Killer cannot hold a three-generator corner.

survivor:deliverance.summary: After a safe rescue of a teammate, you can free yourself from your first hook.
facts: It activates after you safely unhook another Survivor.
