During your first hook stage, your self-unhook always succeeds.
After that you are Broken for 160/140/120 seconds.
It does not work in the second hook stage or when you are the last Survivor alive.
You can use it once per match.
survivor:deliverance.tip: Rescue a teammate early so you have the self-unhook ready for your first hook.

survivor:desperate-measures.summary: The more teammates are hurt, down or hooked, the faster you heal and unhook.
facts: It is active when any Survivor, you included, is not healthy.
You heal and unhook 16/18/20% faster for each injured, downed or hooked Survivor.
The bonus stops at 64/72/80%.
survivor:desperate-measures.tip: Pick it against Killers who injure the whole team.

survivor:detectives-hunch.summary: Each finished generator briefly shows nearby chests, generators and totems.
facts: It triggers each time a generator is completed.
You see chests, generators and totems within 32/48/64 metres.
The reveal lasts 20 seconds.
survivor:detectives-hunch.tip: Use the totem reveal to find and cleanse Hex totems.

survivor:distortion.summary: It blocks the Killer's aura reading on you for a while and recharges during chases.
facts: You start with 1 Token and can hold 2 Tokens.
When the Killer tries to read your aura, it spends 1 Token by itself.
For 8/10/12 seconds the Killer cannot read your aura.
During that time you leave no Scratch Marks.
You gain 1 Token for every 15 seconds you are chased.
It does not trigger while you are down.
survivor:distortion.tip: When a token disappears, the Killer has an aura perk. Change your route.

survivor:diversion.summary: After you lurk unchased in the Terror Radius, you can throw a pebble to send the Killer somewhere else.
facts: It charges after 30/25/20 seconds in the Terror Radius with no chase on you.
Crouch, stand still and press Active Ability to throw a pebble the way you face.
The pebble lands 20 metres away and gives the Killer a Loud Noise Notification there.
It also leaves fake Scratch Marks at that spot.
It turns off after use.
survivor:diversion.tip: Throw the pebble away from your hiding spot just before the Killer turns the corner.

survivor:do-no-harm.summary: You heal teammates who have been hooked more often much faster, and your skill checks pay more.
facts: When you heal another Survivor, you heal 30/35/40% faster for each hook stage they have, up to 60/70/80%.
Great healing skill checks give 3% extra progress for each hook stage, up to 6%.
Skill checks are 5% more likely for each hook stage, up to 5%.
survivor:do-no-harm.tip: Heal teammates on their second hook stage first to get the full bonus.

survivor:down-to-the-last.summary: Hooks and repairs give tokens that help teammates open gates and help you when you are alone.
facts: You gain 1 Token each time you are hooked or repair a generator, up to 6 Tokens.
Each token makes teammates 10% faster at opening Exit Gates.
If you are the only Survivor left and hold 3 or more Tokens, you can open the Hatch without a Key.
In that case each token keeps your aura hidden for 6/8/10 seconds.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:down-to-the-last.tip: Keep repairing generators to stack tokens for the endgame.

survivor:dramaturgy.summary: While healthy you can do a short sprint, followed by one random extra effect that may help or hurt.
facts: It is active while you are at full health.
Press Active Ability while running. You run with high knees for 0.5 seconds, then get +25 Haste for 2 seconds.
Then one random extra effect follows. The same effect never comes twice in a row.
It can give a second Haste burst.
It can make you Exposed for 12 seconds.
It can make you scream.
It can give you a random Rare item with random add-ons, and you drop the item you held.
It does not work while you are Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 seconds.
survivor:dramaturgy.tip: Use it away from the Killer so a bad roll such as Exposed costs you less.

survivor:duty-of-care.summary: When you take a hit for a teammate while healthy, everyone near you gets a burst of speed.
facts: When you are healthy and take a Protection Hit, other Survivors within 12 metres get +25% Haste.
The Haste lasts 4/5/6 seconds.
survivor:duty-of-care.tip: Body-block for an injured teammate so they can sprint to safety.

survivor:empathic-connection.summary: You heal others faster, and injured teammates can see where you are.
facts: You always heal others 30/35/40% faster.
Injured Survivors see your aura so they can find a healer.
survivor:empathic-connection.tip: Work on central generators so injured teammates reach you quickly.

survivor:empathy.summary: You see injured and downed teammates from far away.
facts: Injured and downed Survivors within 64/96/128 metres show to you.
survivor:empathy.tip: Use it to find teammates to heal or to see where the chase is.

survivor:extrasensory-perception.summary: You crouch to see the area around you in growing detail, and you are hard to track but cannot hear the Killer.
facts: It starts after you crouch for 4 seconds.
You see Survivors, the Killer and objects in a radius that grows to 44 metres.
The objects are generators, chests, pallets, windows, totems, items, the Hatch and the Exit Gate.
While it runs you are Elusive and Oblivious.
It ends when you stand up or after 11 seconds.
The cool-down is 60/50/40 seconds.
survivor:extrasensory-perception.tip: Use it right after you spawn or after a chase to plan your next move.

survivor:exultation.summary: A pallet stun on the Killer recharges and upgrades the item you hold.
facts: You must hold an item.
When you stun the Killer with a pallet, your item recharges by 75%.
The item goes up one rarity.
The cool-down is 30/25/20 seconds.
survivor:exultation.tip: Bring a cheap item and stun the Killer to upgrade it during the match.

survivor:eyes-of-belmont.summary: Each finished generator briefly shows the Killer, and every reveal of the Killer lasts longer for you.
facts: When a generator is completed, you see the Killer for 1/2/3 seconds.
Every reveal of the Killer's aura to you lasts 2 seconds longer.
The extra time also applies to its own reveal.
survivor:eyes-of-belmont.tip: Run it with other perks that show the Killer, such as Alert or Fogwise.

survivor:fast-track.summary: Rescues give you tokens, and a Great skill check spends them to cut the work left on a generator.
facts: You gain 1 Token for each Survivor you unhook, up to 1/2/3 Tokens.
A Great repair skill check uses all tokens.
That generator then needs 5 fewer charges for each token, for the rest of the match.
survivor:fast-track.tip: After a rescue, go to a generator and hit a Great skill check soon.

survivor:finesse.summary: While healthy, your fast vaults are quicker, with a cool-down after each one.
facts: It is active while you are healthy.
Your fast vaults are 20% faster.
The cool-down is 40/35/30 seconds after a fast vault.
survivor:finesse.tip: Run to window loops early in a chase while you are still healthy.

survivor:five-moves-ahead.summary: In a chase or near the Killer, you see the nearest pallets and recover faster after you drop one.
facts: It is active while you are chased or inside the Terror Radius.
When you drop a pallet, you can move again 50% sooner.
The 5 nearest pallets show to you.
The cool-down is 40/35/30 seconds after you drop a pallet while it is active.
survivor:five-moves-ahead.tip: On a map you do not know well, use the pallet auras to plan your route.

survivor:fixated.summary: You walk faster and see your own Scratch Marks, so you know how visible your trail is.
facts: You always walk 10/15/20% faster.
You can see your own Scratch Marks.
survivor:fixated.tip: Walk instead of running when the Killer is close, so you leave no trail.

survivor:flashbang.summary: After some repairs, you can make a flash grenade in a locker to blind the Killer.
facts: It activates after 50/45/40% of generator repairs in total.
Inside a locker, press Active Ability to make a Flash Grenade.
It turns off after use.
survivor:flashbang.tip: Throw the grenade when the Killer picks up a teammate.

survivor:flip-flop.summary: Recovering while downed also fills your wiggle bar, so you start ahead if the Killer picks you up.
facts: In the Dying State, recovery also fills your wiggle bar at 50% of the recovery speed.
The wiggle bar fills this way up to 40/45/50%.
survivor:flip-flop.tip: Run it with Unbreakable or Tenacity so you keep recovering while down.

survivor:flow-state.summary: Each finished generator makes you faster at totems, healing and unhooking.
facts: You gain 1 token for each completed generator, up to 5.
Each token makes you 13/14/15% faster at blessing and cleansing totems.
Each token makes you 13/14/15% faster at healing.
Each token makes you 13/14/15% faster at unhooking.
survivor:flow-state.tip: It is strongest late in the match, so take on rescues and heals then.

survivor:fogwise.summary: A Great skill check on a generator shows you where the Killer is.
facts: While you repair, each Great skill check shows you the Killer's aura for 4/5/6 seconds.
survivor:fogwise.tip: Hit Great checks steadily to track the Killer while you repair.

survivor:for-the-people.summary: You heal a teammate one state at once by taking the damage yourself, and you become the Obsession.
facts: It works when you are healthy and heal a teammate without a Med-Kit.
Press Active Ability to give them 1 of your health states.
A downed Survivor, or one with Deep Wound, goes straight to Injured.
An injured Survivor goes straight to full health.
You become injured and Broken for 80/70/60 seconds.
You become the Obsession if you were not already.
Your chance to start as the Obsession drops by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:for-the-people.tip: Use it to pick up a downed teammate fast when the Killer is close.

survivor:friendly-competition.summary: When you finish a generator together with a teammate, you all repair faster for a while.
facts: It triggers when you and at least one teammate complete a generator together.
Everyone who helped repairs 10% faster for 80/85/90 seconds.
survivor:friendly-competition.tip: Move to the next generator together to use the bonus at once.

survivor:fruits-of-your-labor.summary: Every finished generator adds a token, and when you finish one yourself, you get speed and healing.
facts: You gain 1 token each time any generator is completed.
When you finish a generator, each token gives you +5% Haste for 2 seconds.
Each token also gives you 10/15/20% healing progress.
survivor:fruits-of-your-labor.tip: Finish generators yourself late in the match for a large free heal.

survivor:ghost-notes.summary: While you are Exhausted, your trail fades faster and the Exhaustion wears off sooner.
facts: While you are Exhausted, your Scratch Marks fade 50% faster.
Exhaustion wears off 5/7.5/10% faster.
It does not make you Exhausted.
survivor:ghost-notes.tip: Run it with an exhaustion perk such as Sprint Burst to vanish after the sprint.

survivor:hardened.summary: After you open a chest and use a totem, a scream shows you the Killer instead.
facts: It activates once you have opened a chest and blessed or cleansed a totem.
You never scream.
When you would scream, you see the Killer's aura for 3/4/5 seconds instead.
survivor:hardened.tip: It turns Killer scream effects, like the Doctor's, into a free look at the Killer.

survivor:head-on.summary: You hide in a locker and jump out to stun a Killer who stands right in front of it.
facts: It activates after 3 seconds inside a locker.
Hold Sprint while you leave the locker to jump out.
A Killer within 2.5 metres is stunned for 3 seconds.
If you miss, the Killer gets a Loud Noise Notification.
It does not work while you are Exhausted.
After a stun you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 seconds.
survivor:head-on.tip: Hide in a locker just before the Killer rounds the corner in a chase.

survivor:hope.summary: Once the gates have power, you move a little faster for the rest of the match.
facts: After the Exit Gates get power, you have 3/4/5% Haste until the match ends.
survivor:hope.tip: Use the extra speed for endgame rescues.

survivor:hyperfocus.summary: A streak of Great skill checks gives bigger rewards, but the checks come faster and more often.
facts: Each Great skill check while you repair or heal adds 1 Token, up to 6 Tokens.
Each token raises the skill check chance by 4% and the needle speed by 4%, up to 24% each.
Each token adds 10/20/30% of the base Great check bonus, up to 60/120/180%.
You lose all tokens on a Good check, a missed check or an interrupted action.
survivor:hyperfocus.tip: Run it with Stake Out for more Great checks and safer hard ones.

survivor:inner-focus.summary: You see other Survivors' Scratch Marks, and you see the Killer each time they hurt a teammate.
facts: Other Survivors' Scratch Marks are visible to you.
When the Killer takes a health state from another Survivor, you see the Killer for 6/8/10 seconds.
survivor:inner-focus.tip: Follow teammates' Scratch Marks to find heals or to stay away from the chase.

survivor:inner-strength.summary: After you cleanse a totem, a short stay in a locker heals you one state.
facts: It activates after you cleanse any totem.
Stay in any locker for 10/9/8 seconds to heal one health state.
It turns off after use.
It does not work while you are Broken.
survivor:inner-strength.tip: Cleanse a totem early to have a free self-heal ready after your first hit.

survivor:invocation-treacherous-crows.summary: You do a basement ritual that makes crows give away the Killer, and you stay Broken all match.
facts: Press Active Ability at the circle in the Basement to start. The ritual takes 60 seconds.
Other Survivors see your aura and can join. They speed it up by 100% if they have an Invocation perk and by 50% if they do not.
After the ritual, when the Killer startles a crow and a Survivor is in the Terror Radius, all Survivors see the Killer for 1/1.5/2 seconds.
You become injured and stay Broken for the rest of the match.
survivor:invocation-treacherous-crows.tip: Do the ritual early while the Killer is busy far from the Basement.

survivor:invocation-weaving-spiders.summary: You do a basement ritual that makes every generator need fewer charges, and you stay Broken all match.
facts: Press Active Ability at the circle in the Basement to start. The ritual takes 60 seconds.
Other Survivors see your aura and can join. They speed it up by 100% if they have an Invocation perk and by 50% if they do not.
After the ritual, every generator needs 8/9/10 fewer charges for the rest of the match.
You become injured and stay Broken for the rest of the match.
Once it is done, other copies of this Invocation stop working this match.
survivor:invocation-weaving-spiders.tip: Only one Survivor should bring it. Do it early for the biggest gain.

survivor:iron-will.summary: While injured, your grunts of pain get quieter or stop, so the Killer cannot hear where you hide.
facts: While you are injured, your Grunts of Pain are 80/90/100% quieter.
It does not work while you are Exhausted, and it never makes you Exhausted.
survivor:iron-will.tip: Break line of sight in a chase, then stand still behind cover.

survivor:kindred.summary: When anyone is hooked, the team sees each other, and sees the Killer near the hook.
facts: It triggers each time a Survivor is hooked.
All Survivors see the Killer while the Killer is within 14/15/16 metres of that hook.
If you are the one on the hook, all Survivors see each other.
If someone else is hooked, only you see the other Survivors.
survivor:kindred.tip: In solo queue it stops two teammates from going for the same rescue.

survivor:last-stand.summary: After you lurk unchased near the Killer for a while, one fast vault can stun them.
facts: It charges after 120/105/90 seconds in the Terror Radius with no chase on you.
Then your next fast vault gives the Killer a 3-second stun, as long as they are 2.5 metres or closer to the window.
You can use it once per match.
survivor:last-stand.tip: Save it for a window where the Killer follows you closely.

survivor:leader.summary: Teammates near you do most actions faster, and the bonus stays for a while after they leave.
facts: It affects teammates who are 10 metres or closer to you.
They heal, unhook, unlock, cleanse, sabotage and open gates 20/25/30% faster.
The bonus stays for 15 seconds after they leave the area.
Only one Leader can affect a Survivor at a time.
survivor:leader.tip: Stay with teammates during heals and at the gate.

survivor:left-behind.summary: When you are the last Survivor left, you see the Hatch once you get close to it.
facts: It activates when you are the only Survivor left alive.
You see the Hatch within 24/28/32 metres.
survivor:left-behind.tip: Sweep the map in wide loops until the Hatch comes into range.

survivor:lend-a-hand.summary: After you cleanse or bless a totem, you can give a teammate you heal some charges for healing.
facts: It activates after you cleanse or bless a totem.
While you heal a Survivor, press Active Ability 2 to hand them 2/3/4 healing charges that never run out.
You can do this once for each Survivor.
survivor:lend-a-hand.tip: Give the charges to the teammate who will probably be chased next.

survivor:light-footed.summary: While healthy, your running footsteps make no sound, with a pause after each fast vault.
facts: It is active while you are healthy.
Your footsteps make no sound while you run.
The cool-down is 14/12/10 seconds after a fast vault.
survivor:light-footed.tip: Pick it against Killers who track by sound, such as the Spirit.

survivor:lightweight.summary: Your Scratch Marks fade sooner and appear at uneven gaps, so your trail is harder to follow.
facts: Your Scratch Marks last 3/4/5 seconds less.
Scratch Mark patches appear 60% less often and with uneven gaps.
survivor:lightweight.tip: Change direction often in a chase to make the most of the patchy trail.

survivor:lithe.summary: A fast vault gives you a burst of speed to gain distance in a chase.
facts: A fast vault gives you +50% Haste for 3 seconds.
It does not work while you are Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 seconds.
survivor:lithe.tip: Use it at a window that leads to open ground or to the next loop.

survivor:low-profile.summary: When every teammate is down, carried or hooked, you leave no trail for a while.
facts: It triggers when you are the only Survivor who is not downed, carried or hooked.
For 70/80/90 seconds you leave no Grunts of Pain, blood or Scratch Marks.
It turns off after use.
It only counts Survivors who are still in the match.
survivor:low-profile.tip: Use the time to reach the Hatch or a gate, not to rescue.

survivor:lucky-break.summary: While injured you leave no blood or Scratch Marks for a limited time, and healing others refills that time.
facts: It is active while you are injured.
Your blood and Scratch Marks stay hidden for up to 40/50/60 seconds in total.
Time you spend healing another Survivor refills the timer, up to the starting amount.
It ends when the timer runs out or when you are no longer injured.
survivor:lucky-break.tip: Stay injured and heal teammates to keep the timer full.

survivor:lucky-star.summary: Lockers hide your grunts, and when you leave one you see your teammates and the nearest generator.
facts: Inside a locker you make no Grunts of Pain.
For 30 seconds after you leave, you make no grunts and leave no blood.
During that time you see every other Survivor.
You also see the nearest generator in yellow.
The cool-down is 35/30/25 seconds.
survivor:lucky-star.tip: Hide in a locker after a chase, then go to the generator it shows.

survivor:made-for-this.summary: While injured, healing a teammate gives you Endurance, and with Deep Wound you run a bit faster.
facts: It is active while you are injured.
When you finish healing another Survivor, you get Endurance for 6/8/10 seconds.
Any Conspicuous Action ends that Endurance early.
When you run with Deep Wound, you get 1/2/3% Haste.
survivor:made-for-this.tip: Heal teammates while you are injured so a hit does not down you.

survivor:mettle-of-man.summary: After three protection hits you survive one extra hit, but later the Killer sees you when you are far away.
facts: It activates after your third Protection Hit.
While you are injured, it blocks the next hit that would down you.
After you are fully healed, the Killer sees your aura whenever you are more than 12/14/16 metres away.
It turns off when you are downed.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:mettle-of-man.tip: Take protection hits early, then stay injured to keep your aura hidden.

survivor:mirrored-illusion.summary: After some repairs, you create a still copy of yourself next to an object to fool the Killer.
facts: It activates after 20% of generator repairs in total.
Press Active Ability next to a generator, totem, chest or Exit Gate to make an illusion of yourself.
The illusion lasts 40/50/60 seconds.
It turns off after use.
survivor:mirrored-illusion.tip: Put the illusion at a generator far from the one you work on.

survivor:moment-of-glory.summary: After you open a chest, your next injury makes you Broken, but you heal by yourself later.
facts: It activates after you unlock or rummage through a chest 1 time.
When you get injured, you become Broken.
After 80/70/60 seconds you heal 1 health state by yourself.
Going down cancels it.
It does not activate if you are already Broken.
It turns off after it heals you.
survivor:moment-of-glory.tip: Open a chest early so the self-heal is ready for your first hit.

survivor:no-mither.summary: You are Broken all match, but you leave no blood, stay quiet and can pick yourself up.
facts: You are Broken for the whole match.
You leave no blood.
You make no Grunts of Pain while injured or down.
You can pick yourself up from the Dying State.
You recover 15/20/25% faster.
survivor:no-mither.tip: Play it as a chase or stealth challenge, and never count on heals.

survivor:no-one-left-behind.summary: Once the gates have power, you see teammates and heal and unhook them much faster.
facts: It activates when the Exit Gates get power.
You see every other Survivor.
You heal and unhook 80/90/100% faster.
Survivors you unhook get Haste that is 10% stronger and 5 seconds longer, so 20% Haste for 15 seconds.
survivor:no-one-left-behind.tip: Stay for endgame rescues instead of leaving through the gate.

survivor:object-of-obsession.summary: While the Killer reads your aura, you see them and work faster.
facts: It triggers each time the Killer reads your aura and lasts as long as that reading.
During it you see the Killer.
During it you cleanse, heal and repair 8/9/10% faster.
If you are the current Obsession, the Killer sees you for 4 seconds every 30 seconds.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:object-of-obsession.tip: Pick it against Killers with aura perks. As the Obsession you will be found more often.

survivor:off-the-record.summary: After an unhook, aura reading cannot find you and Endurance protects you for a while.
facts: It is active for 30/35/40 seconds after you are unhooked or unhook yourself.
Your aura cannot be revealed.
You make no Grunts of Pain while injured.
You leave no Scratch Marks.
You have Endurance. Any Conspicuous Action ends it early.
It ends and stops working for good when the Exit Gates get power.
survivor:off-the-record.tip: Run away from the hook instead of working, because work ends it.

survivor:one-two-three-four.summary: You perform for nearby teammates, and if you pass the skill checks, they get more skill checks afterwards.
facts: Stand still and press Active Ability to perform for up to 15 seconds.
The performance affects Survivors within 16 metres.
You get a run of skill checks during it.
After a full performance, those Survivors get skill checks 20% more often while healing or repairing, for 90 seconds.
The cool-down is 110/100/90 seconds after you cancel or finish.
survivor:one-two-three-four.tip: Use it when teammates run Hyperfocus or Stake Out.

survivor:open-handed.summary: Every Survivor's own aura-reading perks reach further.
facts: All Survivors always have 8/12/16 metres more range on aura reading.
It only affects auras that come from that Survivor's own perks.
Only one Open-Handed can affect a Survivor at a time.
survivor:open-handed.tip: Run it with Bond, Kindred or Empathy to see most of the map.

survivor:overcome.summary: When you get hit from full health, your speed boost lasts longer, so you reach the next loop.
facts: It triggers when you go from healthy to injured.
The speed boost after the hit lasts 2 seconds longer.
It does not work while you are Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 seconds.
survivor:overcome.tip: Take the first hit in open ground and run to a strong loop.

survivor:overzealous.summary: Cleansing or blessing a totem makes you repair faster until you lose a health state.
facts: It activates after you cleanse or bless a totem.
After a Dull Totem you repair 8/9/10% faster.
After a Hex Totem you repair 16/18/20% faster.
It ends when you lose a health state.
survivor:overzealous.tip: Cleanse totems early, then stay on generators while you are healthy.

survivor:parental-guidance.summary: After you stun the Killer, you leave no sound, blood or tracks for a few seconds.
facts: It triggers after you stun the Killer in any way.
For 5/6/7 seconds you make no Grunts of Pain and leave no Scratch Marks or blood.
survivor:parental-guidance.tip: Stun with a pallet, then change direction to lose the Killer.

survivor:pharmacy.summary: You open chests faster and more quietly, and you always get an Emergency Med-Kit.
facts: You unlock and rummage through chests 75/100/125% faster.
The noise of unlocking carries 12 metres less far.
You always get an Emergency Med-Kit when you finish.
You can rummage through each chest 1 time.
survivor:pharmacy.tip: Open a chest early so you have a Med-Kit when you need it.

survivor:plot-twist.summary: While injured you can go down on purpose, then get up fully healed with a short sprint.
facts: It is active while you are injured.
Crouch, stand still and press Active Ability to drop into the Dying State without a notification to the Killer.
While down you make no grunts and leave no blood.
You can get up by yourself, and you recover 25% faster.
When you get up by yourself, you are fully healed.
Then you get +50% Haste for 2/3/4 seconds.
It stops working after you recover in any way. It can be used once more after the Exit Gates get power.
survivor:plot-twist.tip: Use it out of the Killer's sight to fake a heal.

survivor:plunderers-instinct.summary: You see closed chests and items around the map, and rare items in chests are more likely.
facts: You see closed chests.
You see items in opened chests and items lying on the ground.
Rarer items in chests are 50% more likely.
You unlock chests 150/175/200% faster.
survivor:plunderers-instinct.tip: Run it with Ace in the Hole for strong items with add-ons.

survivor:poised.summary: Each finished generator hides your tracks, and your first repair shows you the Killer briefly.
facts: When a generator is completed, you leave no Scratch Marks for 20/25/30 seconds.
The first time you start on a generator, you see the Killer for 8 seconds.
survivor:poised.tip: Leave as soon as a generator pops, while your trail is hidden.

survivor:potential-energy.summary: You store repair progress as tokens, then put all of it into any generator at once.
facts: Press Active Ability while you repair to start storing.
Your repairs then add tokens instead of progress. You get 1 Token for each 1% of progress, up to 10/15/20 Tokens.
A failed skill check below the cap removes 20% of your tokens.
A failed skill check at the cap makes the generator lose 10%.
With at least 1 Token, press Active Ability at any generator to release them.
The release uses all tokens and adds 1% progress for each token at once.
It turns off after use or when you lose a health state. Losing a health state also clears the tokens.
survivor:potential-energy.tip: Release the tokens on a generator that is almost done to finish it at once.

survivor:power-struggle.summary: While the Killer carries you, you can drop a pallet on them once to get free.
facts: While you are down, you see standing pallets.
It unlocks once your wiggle bar reaches 25/20/15%.
While carried, you can drop a nearby pallet.
The pallet stuns the Killer and frees you.
It turns off after use.
survivor:power-struggle.tip: Crawl toward pallets while you are down so one is close when the Killer picks you up.

survivor:premonition.summary: When you look toward a nearby Killer, you hear a sound and see them briefly.
facts: It works while nobody chases you.
It triggers when you face toward the Killer and they are 32 metres or closer.
You hear a sound cue and see the Killer for 3 seconds.
The cool-down is 55/50/45 seconds.
survivor:premonition.tip: Turn your camera often while you repair to get the warning early.

survivor:prove-thyself.summary: When you repair with teammates, everyone on the generator works faster.
facts: You repair 6/8/10% faster for each other Survivor within 4 metres, up to 18/24/30%.
The bonus applies to all Survivors in that range.
Only one Prove Thyself can affect a Survivor at a time.
survivor:prove-thyself.tip: Group up on one generator while the Killer is busy in a long chase.

survivor:quick-and-quiet.summary: Your fast vaults and fast locker moves make no noise, with a cool-down between them.
facts: Fast vaults over pallets or windows and fast locker entries and exits make no noise.
The Killer gets no Loud Noise Notification from them.
The cool-down is 25/20/15 seconds.
survivor:quick-and-quiet.tip: Jump into a locker out of the Killer's sight to vanish in a chase.

survivor:quick-gambit.summary: While you are chased, you see your teammates and they repair a little faster.
facts: During a chase on you, you see the other Survivors.
During that chase, the other Survivors repair 3/4/5% faster.
The cool-down is 40 seconds after you lose a health state.
survivor:quick-gambit.tip: Lead the Killer away from the teammates you can see working.

survivor:rapid-response.summary: Each time you become Exhausted you see the Killer, and you can make yourself Exhausted to trigger it.
facts: Whenever you become Exhausted, you see the Killer for 2 seconds.
A fast exit from a locker makes you Exhausted for 30/25/20 seconds on purpose.
It cannot replace an Exhaustion you already have.
survivor:rapid-response.tip: Use the locker trick to check where the Killer is before you leave cover.

survivor:reactive-healing.summary: When you are injured and a nearby teammate gets hurt, you get a large part of your heal at once.
facts: You must be injured.
When another Survivor within 32 metres loses a health state, you recover 40/45/50% of the healing you still need.
survivor:reactive-healing.tip: Stay injured near chases to collect free healing.

survivor:reassurance.summary: You stand near a hooked teammate to pause their hook timer, which buys time for a safe rescue.
facts: Stand 6 metres or closer to a hooked teammate and press Active Ability.
Their sacrifice timer pauses for 20/25/30 seconds.
If they are in the Struggle Phase, their struggle skill checks pause too.
That Survivor gets a white outline.
You can use it once per Survivor per hook.
survivor:reassurance.tip: Use it when the Killer camps, then come back later for the rescue.

survivor:red-herring.summary: You mark the generator you repair, then hide in a locker to make the Killer think someone is there.
facts: After at least 1 second of repairs, you see that generator in yellow.
The mark ends when the generator is done, when you start another one, or when you enter a locker.
When you enter a locker, the Killer gets a Loud Noise Notification at the marked generator.
The cool-down is 25/20/15 seconds.
survivor:red-herring.tip: Mark a generator far from you to send the Killer the wrong way.

survivor:repressed-alliance.summary: After some repair time, you make the Entity block your generator to protect its progress.
facts: It activates after 40/35/30 seconds of repairs in total.
Press Active Ability, and the Entity blocks your current generator for 15 seconds.
It turns off after that.
All Survivors see the blocked generator in white.
It only works when no other Survivor is repairing that generator with you.
survivor:repressed-alliance.tip: Block a generator that is almost done before the Killer can kick it.

survivor:residual-manifest.summary: Your blinds stop the Killer from seeing auras for a long time, and a chest gives you a flashlight.
facts: When you blind the Killer, they have Blindness for 20/25/30 seconds.
Once per match you can rummage through an opened chest for a basic Flashlight.
survivor:residual-manifest.tip: Blind the Killer before a rescue to switch off their aura perks.

survivor:resilience.summary: While you are injured, almost every action you do is a little faster.
facts: It is active while you are injured.
You are 7/8/9% faster at blessing or cleansing totems, healing, opening Exit Gates, repairing, sabotaging hooks, searching chests, unhooking and vaulting windows.
survivor:resilience.tip: Stay injured against Killers who cannot down you in one hit.

survivor:resurgence.summary: After an unhook, a large part of your heal is already done.
facts: After you are unhooked in any way, you get 50/60/70% healing progress.
survivor:resurgence.tip: Run it with Self-Care or a Med-Kit to finish the heal quickly.

survivor:road-life.summary: While injured, good repair skill checks build tokens that unlock a fast self-heal.
facts: It works while you are injured and repairing.
A Great repair check adds 1 Token.
A Good repair check adds 0 Tokens.
A missed repair check removes 1 Token.
At 6/5/4 Tokens, all tokens are spent and you can heal yourself, 10% faster than normal.
It turns off 4 seconds after you stop healing yourself.
survivor:road-life.tip: Repair while injured instead of looking for a healer.

survivor:rookie-spirit.summary: After a few good skill checks, you see every regressing generator for the rest of the match.
facts: Pass 5/4/3 Good or Great repair skill checks to turn it on for the match.
You see any generator that is losing progress, for as long as it keeps losing progress.
survivor:rookie-spirit.tip: Tap the generators it shows to stop their regression.

survivor:saboteur.summary: You see hooks while a teammate is carried, and you can sabotage hooks without a Toolbox.
facts: While the Killer carries another Survivor, you see hooks within 56 metres of where they were picked up.
Normal hooks show in white and Scourge Hooks in yellow.
You can sabotage hooks without a Toolbox, 30% faster.
The cool-down is 70/65/60 seconds after a sabotage without a Toolbox.
survivor:saboteur.tip: Only sabotage the hook the Killer is really walking to.

survivor:salvations-cry.summary: When a chase on you starts, your team learns where you and the Killer are.
facts: It triggers when a chase on you begins.
You see the other Survivors for 1/2/3 seconds.
Teammates outside a chase see you for 5 seconds.
For those 5 seconds they see the Killer too.
survivor:salvations-cry.tip: In solo queue it tells teammates they can work safely.

survivor:scavenger.summary: Great skill checks refill an empty Toolbox, and a chest gives you a free Toolbox once.
facts: It works while you hold a depleted Toolbox.
Each Great repair skill check adds 1 Token, up to 5 Tokens.
At 5 Tokens they are spent and the Toolbox is full again.
After a refill you repair 50% slower for 40/35/30 seconds.
Once per match you can rummage through an opened chest for a basic Toolbox.
survivor:scavenger.tip: Keep hitting Great checks with the empty Toolbox to refill it.

survivor:scene-partner.summary: Looking at the Killer inside the Terror Radius makes you scream and shows you the Killer.
facts: It is active inside the Terror Radius.
When you look at the Killer, you scream and see them for 4/5/6 seconds.
With a 50% chance you scream again, which adds 2 seconds.
The cool-down is 40 seconds.
survivor:scene-partner.tip: Each scream tells the Killer where you are, so use it with care.

survivor:second-wind.summary: After you heal a teammate, your next unhook makes you Broken, but you heal yourself soon after.
facts: It activates after you heal others for 1 health state in total.
On your next unhook, by a teammate or by yourself, you become Broken until it ends.
After 28/24/20 seconds you heal 1 health state by yourself.
It ends after that heal, or if you go down before the timer ends.
It does not activate if you are already Broken.
survivor:second-wind.tip: Hide after the unhook until the heal finishes.

survivor:self-care.summary: You can heal yourself without a Med-Kit, but slowly.
facts: You can heal yourself without a Med-Kit.
Your self-heal runs at 25/30/35% of normal healing speed.
survivor:self-care.tip: Heal yourself in a quiet corner away from the Killer's patrol.

survivor:self-preservation.summary: Each time a teammate is hooked, the Killer cannot read your aura for a while.
facts: It triggers whenever another Survivor is hooked.
You are Elusive for 13/14/15 seconds.
survivor:self-preservation.tip: Use that time to go for the rescue unseen.

survivor:shared-trauma.summary: When you take a protection hit, you and nearby Survivors recover from Exhaustion while running.
facts: After a protection hit, you and Survivors within 12 metres recover from Exhausted while running.
This lasts 30/35/40 seconds.
You see Exhausted Survivors within 32 metres.
survivor:shared-trauma.tip: Take a hit for a teammate so both of you get your exhaustion perks back sooner.

survivor:shoulder-the-burden.summary: When you unhook a teammate, you take one of their hook stages, at a high cost to yourself.
facts: You can use it once per match, while you are not on your last hook.
Press Active Ability at a hooked teammate to take them down.
1 of their hook stages moves to you.
You scream, become injured if you were healthy, and are Broken for 160/140/120 seconds.
survivor:shoulder-the-burden.tip: Use it on a teammate who is one hook away from dying.

survivor:slippery-meat.summary: Teammates unhook you much faster, and you get a little more speed after a rescue.
facts: Teammates take you off a hook 90/95/100% faster.
The Haste you get after an unhook is 5% stronger.
survivor:slippery-meat.tip: Faster rescues give the Killer less time to hit the rescuer.

survivor:small-game.summary: You see totems close to you, so you can cleanse Hexes faster.
facts: You see totems within 10/11/12 metres.
survivor:small-game.tip: Run it with Counterforce against Hex builds.

survivor:smash-hit.summary: A pallet stun on the Killer gives you a burst of speed to get away.
facts: A pallet stun on the Killer gives you +50% Haste for 4 seconds.
It does not work while you are Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 30/25/20 seconds.
survivor:smash-hit.tip: Drop pallets early against Killers who are slow to break them.

survivor:sole-survivor.summary: Hooks and repairs give tokens that help teammates open gates and help you when you are alone.
facts: You gain 1 Token each time you are hooked or repair a generator, up to 6 Tokens.
Each token makes teammates 10% faster at opening Exit Gates.
If you are the only Survivor left and hold 3 or more Tokens, you can open the Hatch without a Key.
In that case each token keeps your aura hidden for 6/8/10 seconds.
Your chance to start as the Obsession rises by 100% of the default.
The Killer has only one Obsession at a time.
survivor:sole-survivor.tip: Keep repairing generators to stack tokens for the endgame.

survivor:solidarity.summary: While injured, healing a teammate also heals you.
facts: While you are injured and heal another Survivor, you heal too.
You heal yourself at 65/70/75% of the speed you heal them.
survivor:solidarity.tip: When you and a teammate are both injured, heal them to fix both of you.

survivor:soul-guard.summary: Healing or getting up gives you a short Endurance, and while Cursed you can get up by yourself.
facts: After a heal, or after you get up from the Dying State, you get Endurance for 4/6/8 seconds.
Any Conspicuous Action ends it early.
The cool-down is 30 seconds.
While you are Cursed, you can pick yourself up from the Dying State.
survivor:soul-guard.tip: Against Hex builds, leave one Hex standing to keep the self-recovery.

survivor:specialist.summary: Opening chests gives tokens that you spend on a Great skill check to shorten a generator.
facts: Each chest you open or rummage through adds 1 Token, up to 6 Tokens.
A Great repair skill check uses all tokens.
That generator then needs 2/3/4 fewer charges for each token, up to 12/18/24 charges, for the rest of the match.
survivor:specialist.tip: Open several chests early, then spend the tokens on one generator.

survivor:spine-chill.summary: It warns you when the Killer looks at you from close by, and you vault faster for a moment.
facts: It triggers when the Killer looks at you from 40 metres or closer.
You get a notification.
For 12 seconds you do not scream.
For those 12 seconds your vaults are 10% faster.
The cool-down is 40/35/30 seconds.
survivor:spine-chill.tip: Pick it against stealth Killers such as the Shape or the Ghost Face.

survivor:sprint-burst.summary: When you start running, you get a short sprint, followed by a long Exhaustion.
facts: Starting to run gives you +50% Haste for 2 seconds.
It does not work while you are Exhausted.
Afterwards you are Exhausted for 60/50/40 seconds.
survivor:sprint-burst.tip: Walk between objectives so the sprint is ready when the Killer shows up.

survivor:stake-out.summary: Staying near the Killer without a chase gives tokens that turn skill checks into easy ones that pay more.
facts: You gain 1 Token every 15 seconds while you are in the Terror Radius, 24 metres or closer to the Killer, and not chased. You can hold 2/3/4 Tokens.
During actions with skill checks, normal checks become special ones.
A special check you hit gives 4% more progress.
Each special check, hit or missed, uses 1 Token.
survivor:stake-out.tip: Run it with Hyperfocus to keep a streak of Great skill checks.

survivor:still-sight.summary: When you stand still for a moment, you see the Killer, chests and generators around you.
facts: It activates after you stand still for 4/3/2 seconds.
Within 24 metres you see the Killer, chests and generators.
It ends as soon as you move.
survivor:still-sight.tip: Pause before you leave a generator to check where the Killer is.

survivor:streetwise.summary: Items from chests get many more charges, and the first time your item runs out, you see the Killer.
facts: Items with charges that you take from chests get 60/70/80% more charges for good.
The first time your item runs out, you see the Killer for 8 seconds.
survivor:streetwise.tip: Run it with Plunderer's Instinct to find better chest items.

survivor:strength-in-shadows.summary: In the Basement you can heal yourself without a Med-Kit, and a finished heal there shows you the Killer.
facts: It is active while you are in the Basement.
There you can heal yourself with no Med-Kit, at 70% of normal speed.
When you finish a heal down there, you see the Killer for 6/8/10 seconds.
survivor:strength-in-shadows.tip: Heal in the Basement after the Killer has hooked someone far away.

survivor:teamwork-collective-stealth.summary: After a teammate heals you, neither of you leaves Scratch Marks while you stay close.
facts: It triggers when another Survivor finishes healing you.
You and the healer leave no Scratch Marks while you are 8/12/16 metres or closer to each other.
It holds for 4 seconds out of range and comes back if you get close again in time.
Only one Collective Stealth can affect a Survivor at a time.
survivor:teamwork-collective-stealth.tip: Move together after the heal to hide from Killers who track Scratch Marks.

survivor:teamwork-full-circuit.summary: When you repair with teammates, Good skill checks get easier and you repair a little faster.
facts: Each teammate on your generator makes your Good skill check zone 15/20/25% bigger.
With at least 1 teammate on your generator, you repair 5% faster.
survivor:teamwork-full-circuit.tip: Pair up on generators to miss fewer skill checks.

survivor:teamwork-power-of-two.summary: After you heal someone, both of you move a little faster while you stay close.
facts: It triggers when you finish healing another Survivor.
You and the healed Survivor get +5% Haste while you are 8/12/16 metres or closer to each other.
It holds for 4 seconds out of range and comes back if you get close again in time.
Only one Power of Two can affect a Survivor at a time.
survivor:teamwork-power-of-two.tip: Stay together after the heal to reach the next generator faster.

survivor:teamwork-soft-spoken.summary: When you repair with teammates, the Killer hears the generator from less far, and you repair a little faster.
facts: Each other Survivor on your generator makes its repair noise carry 15/20/25% less far.
With at least 1 teammate on your generator, you repair 5% faster.
survivor:teamwork-soft-spoken.tip: Pick it against Killers who patrol by listening for generators.

survivor:teamwork-throw-down.summary: When you blind the Killer or stun them with a pallet, nearby injured teammates get Endurance.
facts: It triggers when you blind the Killer in any way or stun them with a pallet.
Injured teammates 24 metres or closer get Endurance for 6/8/10 seconds.
survivor:teamwork-throw-down.tip: Go for flashlight saves near injured teammates.

survivor:teamwork-toughen-up.summary: While you are injured, a nearby teammate's blind or pallet stun on the Killer hides your trail for a while.
facts: You must be injured.
It triggers when another Survivor within 24 metres blinds the Killer or stuns them with a pallet.
For 20/25/30 seconds you leave no Grunts of Pain, blood or Scratch Marks.
survivor:teamwork-toughen-up.tip: Run while a teammate stuns the Killer. The Killer will have trouble finding you.

survivor:technician.summary: Your repairs are quieter, and a missed skill check never blows up the generator.
facts: While you repair, the repair noise carries 16 metres less far.
A missed skill check costs 4/3/2% more progress.
A missed check causes no generator explosion and no Loud Noise Notification.
survivor:technician.tip: It suits new players who still miss skill checks.

survivor:tenacity.summary: While you are down, you can crawl and recover at the same time, quickly and quietly.
facts: In the Dying State you can recover while you crawl.
You get 30/40/50% Haste while you crawl.
Your Grunts of Pain are 75% quieter.
Your aura cannot be read.
survivor:tenacity.tip: Crawl toward teammates or out of sight while you recover.

survivor:this-is-not-happening.summary: The Good skill check zone is much bigger while you repair or heal.
facts: While you repair or heal, the Good skill check zone is 150/175/200% bigger.
survivor:this-is-not-happening.tip: Pick it against Killers who make skill checks harder, such as the Doctor.

survivor:troubleshooter.summary: During a chase you see the most advanced generator, and dropping a pallet shows you the Killer.
facts: It is active while you are chased.
The most advanced generator shows to you.
After you drop a pallet, you see the Killer for 4/5/6 seconds.
Both effects stay for 6/8/10 seconds after the chase, then it turns off.
survivor:troubleshooter.tip: Lead the chase away from the generator it shows.

survivor:unbreakable.summary: Once per match, you can get up from the Dying State by yourself after the Killer downs you.
facts: It triggers when the Killer puts you in the Dying State.
You recover 25/30/35% faster.
You can fully recover by yourself.
You can use it once per match.
survivor:unbreakable.tip: Crawl to a safe spot before you get up, or the Killer will down you again.

survivor:up-the-ante.summary: Every Survivor can try to unhook themselves, and the odds improve for each Survivor still alive.
facts: All Survivors can try a self-unhook in the first hook stage.
You gain 1 Token for each Survivor still in the match.
Each token raises every Survivor's luck on self-unhooks by 1/2/3%, up to 3/6/9%.
survivor:up-the-ante.tip: Bring luck offerings and other luck perks with it.

survivor:urban-evasion.summary: You move much faster while crouched, so stealth play is easier.
facts: You always move 90/95/100% faster while crouched.
survivor:urban-evasion.tip: Crouch away from the generator when the Killer arrives.

survivor:valkyries-rage.summary: After a long chase, your next pallet stun lasts much longer.
facts: It activates after you are chased for 40/35/30 seconds.
Your next pallet stun on the Killer lasts 75% longer.
Then it turns off.
survivor:valkyries-rage.tip: Keep the chase going, then drop a pallet at the right moment.

survivor:vigil.summary: You and Survivors near you recover from Exhaustion faster.
facts: Exhaustion wears off 20/25/30% faster.
It also affects all Survivors within 16 metres, and the effect stays for 15 seconds after they leave.
Only one Vigil can affect a Survivor at a time.
survivor:vigil.tip: It works best in a team that runs exhaustion perks.

survivor:visionary.summary: You see generators near you, except for a short break after each one is finished.
facts: You always see generators within 32 metres.
It turns off for 20/18/16 seconds each time a generator is completed.
survivor:visionary.tip: Use it on maps you do not know to find generators quickly.

survivor:wake-up.summary: Once all generators are done, you see the gate switches and open gates faster.
facts: It activates when all generators are completed.
You always see the Exit Gate switches within 128 metres.
While you open a gate, Survivors within 128 metres see you.
You open gates 8/9/10% faster, plus an extra bonus for each living Survivor, up to 68/69/70%. The wiki does not give the size of the extra bonus.
survivor:wake-up.tip: Go straight to the switch it shows.

survivor:we-see-you.summary: Each time the Killer reads your aura you get a token, and at four tokens everyone sees the Killer.
facts: You gain 1 token each time the Killer reveals your aura.
At 4 tokens, all are spent and every Survivor sees the Killer for 10/12.5/15 seconds.
After you gain a token, there is a 10-second cool-down before the next one.
survivor:we-see-you.tip: Pick it against Killers who rely on aura perks.

survivor:well-make-it.summary: After a rescue you heal other Survivors twice as fast for a while.
facts: It is active for 70/80/90 seconds after you unhook another Survivor.
You heal others 100% faster.
survivor:well-make-it.tip: Heal the rescued Survivor right away in a safe spot.

facts: You heal downed Survivors 100% faster.
